name: cozylingo-open-cloze
source: AI 生成（CozyLingo 自研），非第三方题库

questions.content: She ___ to school every day.
questions.explanation: 主语 she 是第三人称单数，一般现在时动词要加 -es。
questions.zh: 她每天去上学。

questions.content: They ___ football on Sundays.
questions.explanation: 主语 they 是复数，一般现在时用动词原形。
questions.zh: 他们星期天踢足球。

questions.content: I ___ coffee every morning.
questions.explanation: 主语 I 用动词原形，表示习惯性动作。
questions.zh: 我每天早上喝咖啡。

questions.content: Look! The baby ___ .
questions.explanation: Look! 提示动作正在发生，用现在进行时 be + doing。
questions.zh: 看！宝宝正在哭。

questions.content: He ___ TV at the moment.
questions.explanation: at the moment 表示此刻正在做，用现在进行时。
questions.zh: 他此刻正在看电视。

questions.content: My sister ___ in a hospital.
questions.explanation: 主语 my sister 是第三人称单数，一般现在时加 -s。
questions.zh: 我姐姐在医院工作。

questions.content: We ___ to the cinema last night.
questions.explanation: last night 是过去时间，用一般过去时。
questions.zh: 我们昨晚去了电影院。

questions.content: She ___ her homework yesterday.
questions.explanation: yesterday 表示过去，动词用过去式 finished。
questions.zh: 她昨天完成了作业。

questions.content: They ___ not at home now.
questions.explanation: 主语 they 用 are；now 提示现在时。
questions.zh: 他们现在不在家。

questions.content: There ___ a book on the desk.
questions.explanation: There be 句型就近一致，a book 是单数，用 is。
questions.zh: 桌上有一本书。

questions.content: ___ you like ice cream?
questions.explanation: 主语 you 的一般现在时疑问句用 Do 开头。
questions.zh: 你喜欢冰淇淋吗？

questions.content: ___ he live in Beijing?
questions.explanation: 主语 he 是第三人称单数，疑问句用 Does，后接动词原形。
questions.zh: 他住在北京吗？

questions.content: I ___ my teeth twice a day.
questions.explanation: twice a day 表示习惯，主语 I 用原形 brush。
questions.zh: 我一天刷两次牙。

questions.content: The sun ___ in the east.
questions.explanation: 客观规律用一般现在时，主语 the sun 单数加 -s。
questions.zh: 太阳从东边升起。

questions.content: It ___ raining outside.
questions.explanation: It 作天气主语，现在进行时用 is raining。
questions.zh: 外面正在下雨。

questions.content: I ___ here since 2019.
questions.explanation: since + 时间点，表示从过去持续到现在，用现在完成时。
questions.zh: 我从 2019 年起就住在这里。

questions.content: She ___ already finished her work.
questions.explanation: 主语 she 单数，现在完成时用 has + 过去分词。
questions.zh: 她已经完成了工作。

questions.content: They ___ married for ten years.
questions.explanation: for + 时间段，从过去持续到现在，用现在完成时。
questions.zh: 他们结婚十年了。

questions.content: When I arrived, they ___ dinner.
questions.explanation: 过去某时刻正在进行的动作用过去进行时。
questions.zh: 我到的时候他们正在吃晚饭。

questions.content: While she ___ , the phone rang.
questions.explanation: while 引导的持续动作用过去进行时，rang 是打断的短暂动作。
questions.zh: 她做饭时电话响了。

questions.content: I ___ my keys, so I couldn't open the door.
questions.explanation: 过去的过去用过去完成时 had + 过去分词。
questions.zh: 我把钥匙丢了，所以打不开门。

questions.content: By the time we got there, the film ___ .
questions.explanation: by the time + 过去时间，主句用过去完成时表示更早发生。
questions.zh: 我们到那儿时，电影已经开始了。

questions.content: Look at those clouds. It ___ rain.
questions.explanation: 有迹象的预测用 be going to。
questions.zh: 看那些云，要下雨了。

questions.content: I ___ call you tomorrow, I promise.
questions.explanation: 临时决定或承诺用 will。
questions.zh: 我明天会给你打电话，我保证。

questions.content: The train ___ at 8:30 tomorrow morning.
questions.explanation: 时刻表安排用一般现在时表示将来。
questions.zh: 火车明天早上 8:30 出发。

questions.content: She ___ her arm last week.
questions.explanation: last week 是明确的过去时间，用一般过去时。
questions.zh: 她上周摔断了胳膊。

questions.content: I ___ never been to Japan.
questions.explanation: 主语 I 用 have；never been 是现在完成时。
questions.zh: 我从没去过日本。

questions.content: He ___ in this company for five years.
questions.explanation: for + 时间段且持续至今，用现在完成时。
questions.zh: 他在这家公司工作五年了。

questions.content: We ___ dinner when the lights went out.
questions.explanation: 过去进行时表示被突发事件打断的持续动作。
questions.zh: 灯灭的时候我们正在吃晚饭。

questions.content: What ___ you do last weekend?
questions.explanation: last weekend 是一般过去时疑问句，用 did + 动词原形。
questions.zh: 你上周末做了什么？

questions.content: The children ___ playing in the garden now.
questions.explanation: 主语 the children 是复数，现在进行时用 are。
questions.zh: 孩子们现在正在花园里玩。

questions.content: I ___ my homework before dinner every day.
questions.explanation: every day 表示习惯，用一般现在时。
questions.zh: 我每天晚饭前做作业。

questions.content: She ___ to Paris next month.
questions.explanation: 已安排好的将来行程可用现在进行时。
questions.zh: 她下个月飞巴黎。

questions.content: They ___ each other since childhood.
questions.explanation: since + 时间点，表示持续状态用现在完成时。
questions.zh: 他们从小就认识。

questions.content: I wish I ___ more time to practise.
questions.explanation: wish 后接与现在事实相反的虚拟语气，用过去式。
questions.zh: 我希望我有更多时间练习。

questions.content: By next June, I ___ this course.
questions.explanation: by + 将来时间，用将来完成时 will have + 过去分词。
questions.zh: 到明年六月，我就完成这门课了。

questions.content: She ___ for two hours when I called.
questions.explanation: 过去完成进行时表示持续到过去某点的动作。
questions.zh: 我打电话时她已经学了两个小时。

questions.content: This time tomorrow I ___ on a beach.
questions.explanation: 将来某时刻正在进行，用将来进行时 will be + doing。
questions.zh: 明天这个时候我正躺在沙滩上。

questions.content: He ___ the report by the time the meeting started.
questions.explanation: by the time + 过去，主句用过去完成时。
questions.zh: 会议开始时他已经写完了报告。

questions.content: I ___ this book three times.
questions.explanation: 表示至今为止的经历次数，用现在完成时。
questions.zh: 这本书我读过三遍。

questions.content: She ___ TV when her mother came home.
questions.explanation: when 引导的短暂动作打断持续动作，持续动作用过去进行时。
questions.zh: 她妈妈回家时她正在看电视。

questions.content: The meeting ___ at ten o'clock tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 日程安排可用一般现在时表示将来。
questions.zh: 会议明天十点开始。

questions.content: I ___ in London for three years before I moved here.
questions.explanation: 在另一个过去动作之前的状态，用过去完成时。
questions.zh: 搬来这里之前我在伦敦住过三年。

questions.content: Don't call me at eight — I ___ dinner then.
questions.explanation: 将来某时刻正在进行，用将来进行时。
questions.zh: 八点别打电话给我，那时我正在吃饭。

questions.content: He ___ for the same company since he graduated.
questions.explanation: since + 过去时间点，动作持续至今，用现在完成进行时。
questions.zh: 他毕业后一直在同一家公司工作。

questions.content: It's the first time I ___ such a beautiful sunset.
questions.explanation: It's the first time 后接现在完成时。
questions.zh: 这是我第一次看到这么美的日落。

questions.content: I ___ him since we were at university.
questions.explanation: since 引导持续到现在的状态，用现在完成时否定式。
questions.zh: 从大学起我就没见过他。

questions.content: While I ___ the dishes, I broke a glass.
questions.explanation: while 引导的持续动作用过去进行时。
questions.zh: 我洗碗时打碎了一个杯子。

questions.content: She ___ her keys, so she had to wait outside.
questions.explanation: 早于另一个过去动作，用过去完成时。
questions.zh: 她忘了带钥匙，只好在外面等。

questions.content: Next year we ___ in this house for twenty years.
questions.explanation: 到将来某时为止已持续多久，用将来完成时。
questions.zh: 明年我们就在这房子里住满二十年了。

questions.content: I ___ to call you, but my phone died.
questions.explanation: 过去某时正在尝试，用过去进行时。
questions.zh: 我正想给你打电话，但手机没电了。

questions.content: He ___ three cups of coffee today.
questions.explanation: today 尚未结束，用现在完成时。
questions.zh: 他今天已经喝了三杯咖啡。

questions.content: When we arrived, the concert ___ .
questions.explanation: 过去之前已发生，用过去完成时。
questions.zh: 我们到时音乐会已经开始了。

questions.content: I ___ for you for half an hour!
questions.explanation: 从过去持续到现在且仍在进行，用现在完成进行时。
questions.zh: 我等了你半个小时了！

questions.content: She ___ at the airport when I arrived.
questions.explanation: 过去某时刻正在等待，用过去进行时。
questions.zh: 我到的时候她正在机场等。

questions.content: Hardly ___ the door when the phone rang.
questions.explanation: Hardly 置于句首要部分倒装，助动词提到主语前。
questions.zh: 我刚关上门电话就响了。

questions.content: No sooner ___ than it began to rain.
questions.explanation: No sooner 置句首触发倒装，用过去完成时。
questions.zh: 我们刚离开就开始下雨了。

questions.content: By the end of this year, the bridge ___ .
questions.explanation: by + 将来时间且为被动，用将来完成时的被动式。
questions.zh: 到今年年底，这座桥将已完工。

questions.content: It's high time we ___ this issue seriously.
questions.explanation: It's high time 后接过去式表示虚拟，意为「早该做了」。
questions.zh: 我们早该认真对待这个问题了。

questions.content: I'd rather you ___ tomorrow.
questions.explanation: would rather 后接从句用过去式表示现在或将来的愿望。
questions.zh: 我宁愿你明天来。

questions.content: He ___ to have left the country last week.
questions.explanation: It is believed that... 的被动转换，主语提前后动词用被动。
questions.zh: 据信他上周已经离开这个国家。

questions.content: The moment she ___ the room, everyone stopped talking.
questions.explanation: the moment 引导时间状语从句，与主句同为过去时。
questions.zh: 她一进房间，所有人都停止了交谈。

questions.content: We ___ the project for months before we got approval.
questions.explanation: 过去完成进行时强调在另一过去动作前持续进行。
questions.zh: 获批之前我们已经筹划这个项目好几个月了。

questions.content: This time next week I ___ my exams.
questions.explanation: 到将来某时已完成，用将来完成时。
questions.zh: 下周这个时候我已经考完了。

questions.content: She ___ to be working when the manager came in.
questions.explanation: 过去某时正在假装，用过去进行时。
questions.zh: 经理进来时她正在假装工作。

questions.content: I ___ the film before, so I knew the ending.
questions.explanation: 早于过去的经历，用过去完成时。
questions.zh: 我看过那部电影，所以知道结局。

questions.content: The company ___ steadily since it was founded.
questions.explanation: since + 过去时间点，持续至今且仍在继续，用现在完成进行时。
questions.zh: 这家公司自成立以来一直在稳步增长。

questions.content: Never ___ such a strange sight.
questions.explanation: Never 置句首，用现在完成时并倒装。
questions.zh: 我从没见过这么奇怪的景象。

questions.content: He said he ___ the letter the day before.
questions.explanation: 间接引语中，比引述动词更早的动作改用过去完成时。
questions.zh: 他说他前一天已经把信寄出了。

questions.content: By the time you read this, I ___ .
questions.explanation: by the time + 现在时表将来，主句用将来完成时。
questions.zh: 你读到这封信时，我已经离开了。

questions.content: I ___ my umbrella, so I got soaked.
questions.explanation: 早于过去的疏忽，用过去完成时。
questions.zh: 我没带伞，所以被淋湿了。

questions.content: She ___ in the garden all morning.
questions.explanation: all morning 且影响到现在，用现在完成进行时。
questions.zh: 她一整个上午都在花园里干活。

questions.content: Scarcely ___ down when the doorbell rang.
questions.explanation: Scarcely 置句首触发倒装，用过去完成时。
questions.zh: 他刚坐下门铃就响了。

questions.content: The house ___ when we arrived.
questions.explanation: 过去某时正在被进行的动作，用过去进行时的被动式。
questions.zh: 我们到时房子正在粉刷。

questions.content: I wish I ___ so much money yesterday.
questions.explanation: wish 后接与过去事实相反的虚拟，用过去完成时。
questions.zh: 我真希望昨天没花那么多钱。

questions.content: Suppose he ___ late — what would we do?
questions.explanation: suppose 引导的假设句用虚拟语气 were。
questions.zh: 假设他迟到了，我们怎么办？

questions.content: The train ___ by the time we reach the station.
questions.explanation: by the time + 现在时，主句用将来完成时。
questions.zh: 等我们到车站，火车已经开走了。

questions.content: He ___ about the problem for weeks before he reported it.
questions.explanation: 早于过去另一动作的状态，用过去完成时。
questions.zh: 上报之前他已经知道这个问题好几周了。

questions.content: I ___ here since eight o'clock and nobody has come.
questions.explanation: 从过去持续到现在，用现在完成进行时。
questions.zh: 我从八点就一直在这儿等，没人来。

questions.content: Were it not for your help, I ___ the deadline.
questions.explanation: Were it not for 是虚拟条件句倒装，指现在事实相反；若指过去则用 would have done。此处搭配过去结果，用 would have missed。
questions.zh: 要不是你帮忙，我就错过截止日期了。

questions.content: Had she listened, she ___ this mistake.
questions.explanation: Had + 主语 + 过去分词是过去虚拟条件句的倒装，主句用 would not have done。
questions.zh: 她要是听了，就不会犯这个错。

questions.content: The committee ___ the proposal for three hours when the vote was called.
questions.explanation: 过去完成进行时表示持续到过去某时点的动作。
questions.zh: 表决时委员会已经辩论了三个小时。

questions.content: Not until much later ___ the truth.
questions.explanation: Not until 置句首，主句用部分倒装。
questions.zh: 直到很久以后我才意识到真相。

questions.content: Only after the results were published ___ the scale of the problem.
questions.explanation: Only + 状语置句首，主句倒装。
questions.zh: 只有在结果公布之后我们才明白问题的规模。

questions.content: He is reported ___ the country two days ago.
questions.explanation: 不定式完成式表示发生在谓语之前的动作。
questions.zh: 据报道他两天前已离开该国。

questions.content: Rarely ___ such a compelling argument.
questions.explanation: Rarely 置句首用现在完成时并倒装。
questions.zh: 我很少听到如此有说服力的论证。

questions.content: By the time the auditors arrived, the records ___ .
questions.explanation: 过去之前已完成的动作，用过去完成时。
questions.zh: 审计人员到时，记录已经不翼而飞。

questions.content: She would rather ___ the offer than compromise her principles.
questions.explanation: would rather 后接动词原形。
questions.zh: 她宁愿拒绝这个提议，也不愿违背原则。

questions.content: The research ___ conclusive evidence so far.
questions.explanation: so far 表示到目前为止，用现在完成时。
questions.zh: 这项研究迄今已得出确凿证据。

questions.content: Little ___ that his decision would change everything.
questions.explanation: Little 置句首，用一般过去时并倒装。
questions.zh: 他几乎不知道他的决定会改变一切。

questions.content: If the data ___ verified earlier, we would not be in this position.
questions.explanation: 与过去事实相反的虚拟条件，用 had been verified。
questions.zh: 如果数据早点核实，我们就不会陷入这个局面。

questions.content: She claimed ___ the documents before signing them.
questions.explanation: claim 后接不定式完成式，表示动作先于谓语发生。
questions.zh: 她声称在签字之前读过那些文件。

questions.content: The policy ___ in force since 2015.
questions.explanation: since + 时间点且持续至今，用现在完成时。
questions.zh: 该政策自 2015 年起一直有效。

questions.content: Under no circumstances ___ the results be disclosed.
questions.explanation: Under no circumstances 置句首本身已含否定，后面用肯定式 should，构成倒装。
questions.zh: 在任何情况下都不得披露结果。

questions.content: He ___ for the post twice before he succeeded.
questions.explanation: 早于过去成功的动作，用过去完成时。
questions.zh: 他成功之前申请过这个职位两次。

questions.content: It is essential that the report ___ by Friday.
questions.explanation: It is essential that 后接虚拟语气 should be，should 常省略，故用 be。
questions.zh: 报告必须在周五前提交。

questions.content: The manuscript ___ missing for over a century.
questions.explanation: for + 时间段且持续至今，用现在完成时。
questions.zh: 这份手稿已经失踪一个多世纪。

questions.content: Nowhere ___ a better explanation.
questions.explanation: Nowhere 置句首，用将来时并倒装。
questions.zh: 你在哪儿都找不到更好的解释了。

questions.content: I would have called, ___ I known you were back.
questions.explanation: Had I known 是 If I had known 的倒装省略形式。
questions.zh: 我要是知道你回来了就打电话了。

questions.content: The theory ___ widely accepted since the 1990s.
questions.explanation: since + 时间点，持续状态用现在完成时。
questions.zh: 该理论自 1990 年代以来被广泛接受。

questions.content: Only when the data ___ complete can we draw conclusions.
questions.explanation: only when 引导的状语从句用一般现在时表示将来，主语 data 作复数。
questions.zh: 只有数据完整时我们才能下结论。

questions.content: He had no sooner sat down ___ the phone rang.
questions.explanation: no sooner... than 是固定搭配。
questions.zh: 他刚坐下电话就响了。

questions.content: Scarcely had they left ___ the storm broke.
questions.explanation: scarcely... when 是固定搭配。
questions.zh: 他们刚走暴风雨就来了。

questions.content: The findings ___ with previous studies.
questions.explanation: 主语 the findings 为复数，动词用原形 accord。
questions.zh: 这些发现与先前的研究一致。

questions.content: I ___ to inform you that your application was unsuccessful.
questions.explanation: 正式书信套语用一般现在时。
questions.zh: 很遗憾地通知您，您的申请未获通过。

questions.content: By 2030, urban populations ___ by nearly a third.
questions.explanation: by + 将来时间，用将来完成时。
questions.zh: 到 2030 年，城市人口将增长近三分之一。

questions.content: Such ___ the demand that tickets sold out in minutes.
questions.explanation: Such 置句首倒装；主语 the demand 单数，事情发生在过去，用 was。
questions.zh: 需求如此之大，票几分钟就卖光了。

questions.content: He insisted that the meeting ___ postponed.
questions.explanation: insist 后接虚拟语气 should be，should 省略后用 be。
questions.zh: 他坚持要求会议推迟。

questions.content: The evidence ___ to be unreliable.
questions.explanation: 表示至今为止的结果，用现在完成时。
questions.zh: 该证据已被证明不可靠。

questions.content: At no point ___ the witness change her story.
questions.explanation: At no point 置句首触发倒装，指过去事件用 did。
questions.zh: 证人自始至终没有改变过说法。

questions.content: ___ is your name?
questions.explanation: 询问姓名用 What is your name?。
questions.zh: 你叫什么名字？

questions.content: This is ___ apple.
questions.explanation: apple 以元音音素开头，用 an。
questions.zh: 这是一个苹果。

questions.content: She is ___ than her brother.
questions.explanation: than 前用比较级 taller。
questions.zh: 她比她哥哥高。

questions.content: I have two ___ .
questions.explanation: child 的复数是不规则形式 children。
questions.zh: 我有两个孩子。

questions.content: There ___ some milk in the fridge.
questions.explanation: milk 不可数，There be 用 is。
questions.zh: 冰箱里有一些牛奶。

questions.content: My father ___ a doctor.
questions.explanation: 主语 my father 是单数第三人称，用 is。
questions.zh: 我父亲是医生。

questions.content: I can ___ swim.
questions.explanation: can 后直接接动词原形，不加 to。
questions.zh: 我会游泳。

questions.content: These ___ my books.
questions.explanation: 主语 these 是复数，用 are。
questions.zh: 这些是我的书。

questions.content: He doesn't ___ any brothers.
questions.explanation: 助动词 doesn't 后接动词原形。
questions.zh: 他没有兄弟。

questions.content: ___ old are you?
questions.explanation: 询问年龄用 How old。
questions.zh: 你多大了？

questions.content: She is good ___ playing the piano.
questions.explanation: be good at 是固定搭配，意为「擅长」。
questions.zh: 她擅长弹钢琴。

questions.content: I'm interested ___ learning Japanese.
questions.explanation: be interested in 是固定搭配。
questions.zh: 我对学日语感兴趣。

questions.content: He is the ___ student in the class.
questions.explanation: the + 最高级表示在范围内最……。
questions.zh: 他是班上最聪明的学生。

questions.content: If it ___ tomorrow, we'll stay at home.
questions.explanation: 条件状语从句用一般现在时表将来。
questions.zh: 如果明天下雨，我们就待在家里。

questions.content: She asked me ___ I was tired.
questions.explanation: 一般疑问句转间接引语用 if 或 whether 引导。
questions.zh: 她问我是否累了。

questions.content: The book ___ I bought yesterday is very good.
questions.explanation: 先行词 the book 是物，关系代词用 which。
questions.zh: 我昨天买的那本书很好。

questions.content: He has been working here ___ 2018.
questions.explanation: since 接时间点，for 接时间段。
questions.zh: 他从 2018 年起就在这里工作。

questions.content: Would you like ___ tea?
questions.explanation: 表示委婉的邀请或请求时，疑问句也用 some。
questions.zh: 你想喝点茶吗？

questions.content: It's the ___ film I've ever seen.
questions.explanation: the worst 是 bad 的最高级。
questions.zh: 这是我看过最差的电影。

questions.content: You ___ smoke here. It's forbidden.
questions.explanation: mustn't 表示禁止；needn't 表示不必。
questions.zh: 你不能在这儿吸烟，这是禁止的。

questions.content: She's been ill ___ three days.
questions.explanation: for 后接时间段 three days。
questions.zh: 她病了三天了。

questions.content: I'd like ___ to the concert.
questions.explanation: would like 后接不定式。
questions.zh: 我想去听音乐会。

questions.content: He's used to ___ up early.
questions.explanation: be used to 中的 to 是介词，后接动名词。
questions.zh: 他习惯早起。

questions.content: Neither Tom ___ his friends were there.
questions.explanation: neither... nor 是固定搭配。
questions.zh: 汤姆和他的朋友们都不在那里。

questions.content: The letter ___ by Tom yesterday.
questions.explanation: 过去被动语态用 was/were + 过去分词。
questions.zh: 这封信是汤姆昨天写的。

questions.content: It's no use ___ about it now.
questions.explanation: It's no use 后接动名词。
questions.zh: 现在担心这个没有用。

questions.content: I look forward to ___ from you.
questions.explanation: look forward to 中的 to 是介词，后接动名词。
questions.zh: 期待收到你的来信。

questions.content: Hardly had I arrived ___ it started snowing.
questions.explanation: hardly... when 是固定搭配，表「刚一……就」。
questions.zh: 我刚到就开始下雪了。

questions.content: Not only ___ late, but he also forgot the file.
questions.explanation: Not only 置句首时主句倒装。
questions.zh: 他不仅迟到了，还忘了带文件。

questions.content: I'd rather ___ at home tonight.
questions.explanation: would rather 后接动词原形。
questions.zh: 今晚我宁愿待在家里。

questions.content: She suggested ___ the meeting until Monday.
questions.explanation: suggest 后接动名词，不接不定式。
questions.zh: 她建议把会议推迟到周一。

questions.content: The more you practise, ___ you become.
questions.explanation: the more... the more... 表示「越……越……」。
questions.zh: 练得越多，你就越好。

questions.content: He denied ___ the money.
questions.explanation: deny 后接动名词。
questions.zh: 他否认拿了那笔钱。

questions.content: It was the first time she ___ abroad.
questions.explanation: It was the first time 后接过去完成时。
questions.zh: 那是她第一次出国。

questions.content: I wish I ___ how to drive.
questions.explanation: wish 后接与现在事实相反的虚拟，用过去式。
questions.zh: 我真希望我会开车。

questions.content: There's no point ___ with him.
questions.explanation: There's no point (in) 后接动名词。
questions.zh: 跟他争论没有意义。

questions.content: He's looking forward to ___ his family.
questions.explanation: look forward to 的 to 是介词，接动名词。
questions.zh: 他期待见到家人。

questions.content: Neither of the answers ___ correct.
questions.explanation: neither of + 复数名词作主语时，谓语通常用单数。
questions.zh: 两个答案都不对。

questions.content: ___ the bad weather, we enjoyed the trip.
questions.explanation: Despite 是介词，后接名词短语；Although 后接从句。
questions.zh: 尽管天气不好，我们还是很享受这次旅行。

questions.content: He ___ to have stolen the painting.
questions.explanation: It is believed that he... 的被动转换。
questions.zh: 据信是他偷了那幅画。

questions.content: I can't help ___ when I watch that film.
questions.explanation: can't help 后接动名词，意为「忍不住」。
questions.zh: 我看那部电影时忍不住哭。

questions.content: By the time he arrived, we ___ for an hour.
questions.explanation: 过去完成进行时表示持续到过去某时点。
questions.zh: 他到的时候我们已经等了一个小时。

questions.content: It's important ___ the instructions carefully.
questions.explanation: It's important 后用不定式作真正主语。
questions.zh: 仔细阅读说明书很重要。

questions.content: The film was so boring that I ___ asleep.
questions.explanation: fall asleep 意为「睡着」，此处用过去式 fell。
questions.zh: 这部电影太无聊了，我睡着了。

questions.content: She made me ___ the whole story again.
questions.explanation: make 作使役动词，后接不带 to 的不定式。
questions.zh: 她让我把整件事又说了一遍。

questions.content: No sooner had we sat down ___ the show began.
questions.explanation: no sooner... than 是固定搭配。
questions.zh: 我们刚坐下演出就开始了。

questions.content: You'd better ___ a doctor.
questions.explanation: had better 后接动词原形。
questions.zh: 你最好去看医生。

questions.content: This is the man ___ car was stolen.
questions.explanation: 表示所属关系用 whose。
questions.zh: 这就是那个车被偷的人。

questions.content: I'm not used to ___ so early.
questions.explanation: be used to 的 to 是介词，接动名词。
questions.zh: 我不习惯这么早起床。

questions.content: He apologised ___ being late.
questions.explanation: apologise for 是固定搭配。
questions.zh: 他为迟到道歉。

questions.content: ___ had she finished speaking when the audience applauded.
questions.explanation: Hardly... when 是固定搭配，No sooner 需配 than。
questions.zh: 她刚说完观众就鼓掌了。

questions.content: Such ___ his anger that he could hardly speak.
questions.explanation: Such 置句首倒装，主语 his anger 单数，指过去用 was。
questions.zh: 他气得几乎说不出话。

questions.content: The proposal, ___ was submitted last week, has been approved.
questions.explanation: 非限制性定语从句不用 that，指物用 which。
questions.zh: 上周提交的那份提案已经获批。

questions.content: It is essential that he ___ present at the meeting.
questions.explanation: It is essential that 后接虚拟语气，用动词原形 be。
questions.zh: 他必须出席会议。

questions.content: Not until I got home ___ I had left my phone.
questions.explanation: Not until 置句首，主句用部分倒装。
questions.zh: 直到回家我才发现手机落下了。

questions.content: He would rather ___ than apologise.
questions.explanation: would rather do A than do B，两侧都用动词原形。
questions.zh: 他宁愿辞职也不道歉。

questions.content: The data ___ that the theory is flawed.
questions.explanation: data 作复数，谓语用 suggest；suggests 也可接受但此处按复数一致。
questions.zh: 数据表明该理论有缺陷。

questions.content: ___ for the delay, the flight finally took off.
questions.explanation: Despite 是介词，后接名词短语。
questions.zh: 尽管延误了，航班还是起飞了。

questions.content: He is said ___ in Canada.
questions.explanation: 表示目前正在的状态，用不定式进行式。
questions.zh: 据说他目前住在加拿大。

questions.content: Only by working together ___ the problem.
questions.explanation: Only + 状语置句首，主句倒装。
questions.zh: 只有齐心协力我们才能解决这个问题。

questions.content: I'd sooner you ___ anything to her.
questions.explanation: would sooner 后接从句用过去式表示虚拟。
questions.zh: 我宁愿你什么都没跟她说。

questions.content: She insisted on ___ the bill herself.
questions.explanation: insist on 中的 on 是介词，接动名词。
questions.zh: 她坚持自己付账。

questions.content: Were I ___ you, I would accept the offer.
questions.explanation: Were I you 是 If I were you 的倒装形式。
questions.zh: 如果我是你，我就接受这个提议。

questions.content: The project is far from ___ .
questions.explanation: far from + 形容词，表示「远非……」。
questions.zh: 这个项目远未完成。

questions.content: He tends ___ late for meetings.
questions.explanation: tend 后接不定式。
questions.zh: 他开会常常迟到。

questions.content: ___ the rain, the match was cancelled.
questions.explanation: owing to 是复合介词，后接名词。
questions.zh: 由于下雨，比赛取消了。

questions.content: I have no intention of ___ .
questions.explanation: intention of 后接动名词。
questions.zh: 我没有辞职的打算。

questions.content: He was made ___ the truth.
questions.explanation: make 用于被动语态时，不定式要带 to。
questions.zh: 他被迫说出了真相。

questions.content: Rarely ___ a more convincing argument.
questions.explanation: Rarely 置句首触发倒装，用现在完成时。
questions.zh: 我很少听到更有说服力的论证。

questions.content: The sooner we start, ___ .
questions.explanation: the sooner... the better 是固定结构。
questions.zh: 越早开始越好。

questions.content: ___ the committee's objections, the plan went ahead.
questions.explanation: Notwithstanding 是正式介词，意为「尽管」，后接名词。
questions.zh: 尽管委员会反对，计划还是推进了。

questions.content: Little ___ the consequences of his actions.
questions.explanation: Little 置句首触发倒装，指过去用 did。
questions.zh: 他几乎没有预料到行为的后果。

questions.content: Should you require assistance, ___ hesitate to ask.
questions.explanation: Should you require... 是条件句倒装，主句用祈使句 do not。
questions.zh: 如需帮助，请不必客气。

questions.content: The findings, ___ were unexpected, prompted further study.
questions.explanation: 非限制性定语从句用 which，不用 that。
questions.zh: 这些出人意料的发现促成了进一步研究。

questions.content: It is imperative that the funds ___ accounted for.
questions.explanation: It is imperative that 后接虚拟语气 be。
questions.zh: 这些资金必须交代清楚。

questions.content: He is credited ___ the technique.
questions.explanation: be credited with 后接动名词，意为「被认为发明了……」。
questions.zh: 这项技术被归功于他。

questions.content: ___ no account should the door be left unlocked.
questions.explanation: on no account 意为「绝不」，是固定搭配。
questions.zh: 绝不能不上锁就离开这扇门。

questions.content: The extent ___ which the policy succeeded remains unclear.
questions.explanation: the extent to which 是固定搭配。
questions.zh: 该政策在多大程度上奏效仍不清楚。

questions.content: She is reputed ___ a fortune in property.
questions.explanation: 不定式完成式表示先于谓语发生的动作。
questions.zh: 据说她靠房地产赚了一大笔钱。

questions.content: ___ being overpriced, the hotel was fully booked.
questions.explanation: Despite 后接名词或动名词，表示让步。
questions.zh: 尽管价格过高，这家酒店还是订满了。

questions.content: Under no circumstances ___ the media be granted access.
questions.explanation: Under no circumstances 本身含否定，后接肯定式 should，构成倒装。
questions.zh: 任何情况下都不应允许媒体进入。

questions.content: The proposal is worthy of ___ serious consideration.
questions.explanation: be worthy of 后接动名词。
questions.zh: 该提案值得认真考虑。

questions.content: He made no attempt ___ his mistake.
questions.explanation: make an attempt to do 是固定结构。
questions.zh: 他没有尝试纠正自己的错误。

questions.content: ___ that he was being watched, he changed his route.
questions.explanation: 现在分词作状语，与主句主语 he 是主动关系。
questions.zh: 怀疑自己被跟踪，他改变了路线。

questions.content: The committee, ___ members disagreed, reached no decision.
questions.explanation: 表示所属关系用 whose。
questions.zh: 委员会内部意见不一，未达成任何决定。

questions.content: He would have succeeded ___ for his lack of patience.
questions.explanation: but for 意为「要不是」，表虚拟条件。
questions.zh: 要不是缺乏耐心，他就成功了。

questions.content: Seldom ___ such a well-argued case.
questions.explanation: Seldom 置句首触发倒装，用现在完成时。
questions.zh: 我很少读到论证如此充分的案例。

questions.content: There is little prospect of the dispute ___ soon.
questions.explanation: prospect of 后接动名词。
questions.zh: 这场争端短期内解决的可能性很小。

questions.content: ___ as it may seem, the theory has held up.
questions.explanation: as 引导让步倒装时，形容词提到句首且不带冠词。
questions.zh: 尽管听起来奇怪，这个理论一直站得住脚。

questions.content: The manager denied ___ informed of the decision.
questions.explanation: deny 后接动名词；表示更早且被动，用 having been done。
questions.zh: 经理否认曾被告知这个决定。

questions.content: He ___ to the park yesterday.
questions.explanation: 主语 he + 过去时间 yesterday，用过去式 went。
questions.zh: 他昨天去了公园。

questions.content: The cat ___ on the sofa.
questions.explanation: 一般现在时，主语 the cat 单数，动词加 -s。
questions.zh: 猫在沙发上睡觉。

questions.content: ___ you like some water?
questions.explanation: Would you like...? 是提出邀请的固定句式。
questions.zh: 你想喝点水吗？

questions.content: I have ___ orange and a banana.
questions.explanation: orange 以元音音素开头，用 an。
questions.zh: 我有一个橙子和一根香蕉。

questions.content: They are ___ in the classroom.
questions.explanation: are + doing 构成现在进行时。
questions.zh: 他们正在教室里学习。

questions.content: My mother ___ dinner every evening.
questions.explanation: every evening 表习惯，主语单数用 cooks。
questions.zh: 我妈妈每天晚上做饭。

questions.content: There ___ two apples on the table.
questions.explanation: two apples 是复数，There be 用 are。
questions.zh: 桌上有两个苹果。

questions.content: She can ___ the guitar.
questions.explanation: 情态动词 can 后接动词原形。
questions.zh: 她会弹吉他。

questions.content: ___ is my brother.
questions.explanation: 作主语用主格 He。
questions.zh: 他是我哥哥。

questions.content: We ___ not go to school on Sunday.
questions.explanation: 主语 we 的否定句用 do not。
questions.zh: 我们星期天不上学。

questions.content: The boy ___ won the race is my cousin.
questions.explanation: 先行词 the boy 指人，关系代词用 who。
questions.zh: 赢得比赛的那个男孩是我表弟。

questions.content: I don't know ___ he will come.
questions.explanation: 宾语从句表示「是否」用 if 或 whether。
questions.zh: 我不知道他是否会来。

questions.content: She asked me where I ___ .
questions.explanation: 间接引语中主句为过去时，从句时态要相应后退。
questions.zh: 她问我住在哪里。

questions.content: It is important ___ we arrive on time.
questions.explanation: It is important that... 用 that 引导主语从句。
questions.zh: 我们准时到达很重要。

questions.content: The reason ___ he left is unclear.
questions.explanation: 先行词 reason 后接关系副词 why。
questions.zh: 他离开的原因不清楚。

questions.content: ___ he was tired, he kept working.
questions.explanation: Although 引导让步状语从句。
questions.zh: 尽管很累，他还是继续工作。

questions.content: This is the house ___ I was born.
questions.explanation: 先行词是地点，且在从句中作状语，用 where。
questions.zh: 这就是我出生的房子。

questions.content: I'll call you ___ I arrive.
questions.explanation: when 引导时间状语从句，表示「当……时」。
questions.zh: 我到了就给你打电话。

questions.content: He is taller ___ I am.
questions.explanation: 比较级后用 than。
questions.zh: 他比我高。

questions.content: She was so tired ___ she fell asleep at once.
questions.explanation: so + 形容词 + that 引导结果状语从句。
questions.zh: 她太累了，立刻就睡着了。

questions.content: I like the way ___ she speaks.
questions.explanation: the way 后的定语从句可用 that 或省略关系词。
questions.zh: 我喜欢她说话的方式。

questions.content: ___ the rain stops, we'll go out.
questions.explanation: as soon as 表示「一……就……」。
questions.zh: 雨一停我们就出去。

questions.content: It was in 2010 ___ they first met.
questions.explanation: 强调句 It was... that... 结构，强调时间状语。
questions.zh: 他们是在 2010 年第一次见面的。

questions.content: ___ he said made everyone laugh.
questions.explanation: what 引导主语从句，并在从句中作 said 的宾语。
questions.zh: 他说的话把大家都逗笑了。

questions.content: The fact ___ he lied surprised nobody.
questions.explanation: 同位语从句用 that 引导，说明 fact 的内容。
questions.zh: 他撒谎这件事没人感到意外。

questions.content: No matter ___ hard he tried, he failed.
questions.explanation: no matter how + 形容词/副词，表示「无论多么」。
questions.zh: 无论他多努力，都失败了。

questions.content: She spoke slowly ___ everyone could follow.
questions.explanation: so that 引导目的状语从句。
questions.zh: 她讲得很慢，好让大家都能跟上。

questions.content: ___ you finish, let me know.
questions.explanation: when 引导时间状语从句，指将来的某个时点。
questions.zh: 你完成时告诉我一声。

questions.content: This is the reason ___ I called you.
questions.explanation: 先行词 reason 后接关系副词 why。
questions.zh: 这就是我给你打电话的原因。

questions.content: I'd rather you ___ me the truth.
questions.explanation: would rather 后接从句用过去式表示虚拟。
questions.zh: 我宁愿你告诉我真相。

questions.content: ___ he arrives, we'll start.
questions.explanation: the moment 可作连词，表示「一……就……」。
questions.zh: 他一到我们就开始。

questions.content: It doesn't matter ___ you come or not.
questions.explanation: whether... or not 是固定结构。
questions.zh: 你来不来都无所谓。

questions.content: The more she practised, ___ confident she became.
questions.explanation: the more... the more... 表示同步递增。
questions.zh: 她练得越多就越自信。

questions.content: He behaved as if he ___ the place.
questions.explanation: as if 引导的从句与现在事实相反时用过去式。
questions.zh: 他的举动好像他拥有这个地方一样。

questions.content: ___ it rains, we'll postpone the picnic.
questions.explanation: in case 后接从句；in case of 后接名词。
questions.zh: 万一下雨，我们就推迟野餐。

questions.content: Not until she left ___ how much I missed her.
questions.explanation: Not until 置句首，主句用部分倒装。
questions.zh: 直到她离开我才意识到我有多想她。

questions.content: The man ___ we spoke to was very helpful.
questions.explanation: 关系代词作介词宾语，指人用 whom。
questions.zh: 我们交谈过的那个人很热心。

questions.content: ___ hard he tried, he couldn't solve it.
questions.explanation: However + 形容词/副词，表示「无论多么」。
questions.zh: 无论他多努力都解决不了。

questions.content: Only when the results came in ___ the scale of the problem.
questions.explanation: Only + 状语从句置句首，主句倒装。
questions.zh: 只有在结果出来时我们才看到问题的规模。

questions.content: The assumption ___ markets self-correct is contested.
questions.explanation: 同位语从句用 that 引导，说明 assumption 的内容。
questions.zh: 市场能自我修正这一假设是有争议的。

questions.content: It was not until midnight ___ he finished.
questions.explanation: not until 的强调句用 It was not until... that...。
questions.zh: 直到午夜他才完成。

questions.content: ___ the evidence suggests, the case is far from closed.
questions.explanation: as 引导非限制性定语从句，指代整个主句。
questions.zh: 正如证据所示，案件远未结案。

questions.content: He spoke as though he ___ there himself.
questions.explanation: as though 引导的虚拟从句用 were。
questions.zh: 他讲得好像他亲自在场一样。

questions.content: ___ that he was late, he apologised.
questions.explanation: 现在分词作状语，与主语 he 是主动关系。
questions.zh: 知道自己迟到了，他道了歉。

questions.content: The question is ___ the plan is feasible.
questions.explanation: 表语从句表示「是否」用 whether。
questions.zh: 问题在于这个计划是否可行。

questions.content: ___ having little experience, she handled it well.
questions.explanation: Despite 是介词，后接动名词。
questions.zh: 尽管经验不多，她处理得很好。

questions.content: Such was the noise ___ we could hardly hear.
questions.explanation: Such... that 引导结果状语从句。
questions.zh: 噪音大得我们几乎听不见。

questions.content: Whatever ___ , don't give up.
questions.explanation: whatever 引导的状语从句用一般现在时表将来。
questions.zh: 无论发生什么，都别放弃。

questions.content: The report, ___ was leaked, caused a scandal.
questions.explanation: 非限制性定语从句不用 that。
questions.zh: 那份被泄露的报告引发了一场丑闻。

questions.content: ___ he had any idea, he said nothing.
questions.explanation: if 引导条件状语从句，表示「如果」。
questions.zh: 如果说他有什么想法，他什么也没说。

questions.content: ___ is often the case with such studies, the sample was small.
questions.explanation: as is often the case 是固定结构，as 指代整个主句。
questions.zh: 正如这类研究常见的情况，样本量很小。

questions.content: It is not so much the cost ___ the delay that worries us.
questions.explanation: not so much A as B 是固定结构，意为「与其说是 A 不如说是 B」。
questions.zh: 让我们担心的与其说是成本，不如说是延误。

questions.content: The degree ___ the two are related is disputed.
questions.explanation: the degree to which 是固定搭配。
questions.zh: 两者相关程度有多大仍有争议。

questions.content: ___ the outcome, the process was worthwhile.
questions.explanation: whatever + 名词，表示「无论……是什么」。
questions.zh: 无论结果如何，这个过程都值得。

questions.content: He resigned, ___ came as no surprise.
questions.explanation: which 引导非限制性定语从句，指代整个主句。
questions.zh: 他辞职了，这一点也不意外。

questions.content: Not only did she apologise, ___ she also offered compensation.
questions.explanation: not only... but also... 是固定搭配。
questions.zh: 她不仅道了歉，还提出了赔偿。

questions.content: ___ the critics say, the film has merit.
questions.explanation: whatever 引导让步状语从句，在从句中作 say 的宾语。
questions.zh: 不管评论家怎么说，这部电影有价值。

questions.content: It was not the money ___ the principle that mattered.
questions.explanation: not A but B 表示「不是 A 而是 B」。
questions.zh: 重要的不是钱，而是原则。

questions.content: The more carefully one reads, ___ one notices.
questions.explanation: the more... the more... 结构，两边都要 the + 比较级。
questions.zh: 读得越仔细，注意到的东西越多。

questions.content: ___ be the case, we must act now.
questions.explanation: Should that be the case 是 If that should be the case 的倒装省略。
questions.zh: 若果真如此，我们必须现在行动。

questions.content: I need to ___ a decision quickly.
questions.explanation: make a decision 是固定搭配，意为「做决定」。
questions.zh: 我需要很快做出决定。

questions.content: Can you ___ me a favour?
questions.explanation: do sb a favour 是固定搭配，意为「帮某人一个忙」。
questions.zh: 你能帮我个忙吗？

questions.content: She ___ a photo of the sunset.
questions.explanation: take a photo 是固定搭配，意为「拍照」。
questions.zh: 她拍了一张日落的照片。

questions.content: Let's ___ a break.
questions.explanation: take a break 是固定搭配，意为「休息一下」。
questions.zh: 我们休息一下吧。

questions.content: I ___ a mistake in the test.
questions.explanation: make a mistake 是固定搭配，意为「犯错」。
questions.zh: 我在考试中犯了一个错误。

questions.content: He ___ his homework after dinner.
questions.explanation: do homework 是固定搭配，意为「做作业」。
questions.zh: 他晚饭后做作业。

questions.content: Please ___ attention to the teacher.
questions.explanation: pay attention to 是固定搭配，意为「注意」。
questions.zh: 请注意听老师讲。

questions.content: We should ___ care of the environment.
questions.explanation: take care of 是固定搭配，意为「照顾、爱护」。
questions.zh: 我们应该爱护环境。

questions.content: The film was very ___ ; I laughed a lot.
questions.explanation: funny 意为「好笑的」；fun 多指「有趣的（事）」。
questions.zh: 这部电影很好笑，我笑了很多次。

questions.content: I was ___ in the story from the beginning.
questions.explanation: 人作主语描述感受用 -ed 形式 interested。
questions.zh: 我从一开始就对故事感兴趣。

questions.content: She gave me some useful ___ .
questions.explanation: advice 是不可数名词，没有复数形式。
questions.zh: 她给了我一些有用的建议。

questions.content: There is a lot of ___ in the room.
questions.explanation: furniture 是不可数名词。
questions.zh: 房间里有很多家具。

questions.content: Could you give me some ___ about hotels?
questions.explanation: information 是不可数名词。
questions.zh: 你能给我一些关于酒店的信息吗？

questions.content: He has made great ___ in English.
questions.explanation: progress 是不可数名词，make progress 意为「取得进步」。
questions.zh: 他的英语取得了很大进步。

questions.content: The weather is ___ today.
questions.explanation: 描述天气好可用 good；well 多指身体健康。
questions.zh: 今天天气很好。

questions.content: He speaks English ___ .
questions.explanation: 修饰动词 speaks 用副词 well。
questions.zh: 他英语说得很好。

questions.content: I ___ my keys on the table.
questions.explanation: leave sth somewhere 意为「把某物落在某处」。
questions.zh: 我把钥匙落在桌上了。

questions.content: I ___ the train this morning.
questions.explanation: miss the train 意为「错过火车」。
questions.zh: 我今天早上错过了火车。

questions.content: Can you ___ me the way to the station?
questions.explanation: tell sb sth 结构；say 后一般直接接内容。
questions.zh: 你能告诉我怎么去车站吗？

questions.content: She ___ three languages fluently.
questions.explanation: 说某种语言用 speak。
questions.zh: 她能流利地说三种语言。

questions.content: We ___ about the plan for hours.
questions.explanation: talk about sth 意为「谈论某事」。
questions.zh: 我们讨论这个计划讨论了好几个小时。

questions.content: I'd like to ___ a complaint.
questions.explanation: make a complaint 是固定搭配，意为「投诉」。
questions.zh: 我想提出投诉。

questions.content: Please ___ your time — there's no rush.
questions.explanation: take your time 意为「慢慢来，不着急」。
questions.zh: 慢慢来，不用急。

questions.content: The doctor told him to ___ weight.
questions.explanation: lose weight 意为「减重」；loose 是形容词「松的」。
questions.zh: 医生让他减重。

questions.content: I have to ___ an appointment with the dentist.
questions.explanation: make an appointment 是固定搭配，意为「预约」。
questions.zh: 我得跟牙医预约。

questions.content: The two theories are ___ different.
questions.explanation: 修饰形容词 different 用副词 completely。
questions.zh: 这两种理论完全不同。

questions.content: He was ___ accused of theft.
questions.explanation: 修饰动词 accused 用副词 wrongly。
questions.zh: 他被错误地指控偷窃。

questions.content: She has a strong ___ of humour.
questions.explanation: a sense of humour 是固定搭配，意为「幽默感」。
questions.zh: 她很有幽默感。

questions.content: This medicine has no side ___ .
questions.explanation: side effect 意为「副作用」；affect 是动词。
questions.zh: 这种药没有副作用。

questions.content: The new policy will ___ everyone.
questions.explanation: affect 是动词「影响」；effect 多作名词。
questions.zh: 新政策将影响每个人。

questions.content: I'm afraid I ___ with you.
questions.explanation: disagree with sb 意为「不同意某人」。
questions.zh: 恐怕我不同意你的看法。

questions.content: He ___ to the plan without hesitation.
questions.explanation: agree to a plan 意为「同意某个计划」；此处 agree 后直接跟 to the plan 作宾语补足语结构，用 agreed 最简。
questions.zh: 他毫不犹豫地同意了该计划。

questions.content: The company had to ___ its workforce.
questions.explanation: reduce 意为「削减」；refuse/reject 是「拒绝」。
questions.zh: 公司不得不裁员。

questions.content: Please ___ me of the meeting tomorrow.
questions.explanation: remind sb of sth 意为「提醒某人某事」。
questions.zh: 请提醒我明天的会议。

questions.content: I can't ___ to buy a new car.
questions.explanation: can't afford to do 意为「负担不起」。
questions.zh: 我买不起新车。

questions.content: She ___ a lot of effort into the project.
questions.explanation: put effort into 意为「在……上投入精力」。
questions.zh: 她在这个项目上投入了很多精力。

questions.content: We must ___ the problem seriously.
questions.explanation: take sth seriously 意为「认真对待某事」。
questions.zh: 我们必须认真对待这个问题。

questions.content: The plan fell ___ because of lack of funding.
questions.explanation: fall through 意为「（计划）落空、失败」。
questions.zh: 由于资金不足，计划落空了。

questions.content: I need to ___ up my mind.
questions.explanation: make up one's mind 意为「下定决心」。
questions.zh: 我需要下定决心。

questions.content: He ___ up with a brilliant idea.
questions.explanation: come up with 意为「想出（主意）」。
questions.zh: 他想出了一个绝妙的主意。

questions.content: Don't ___ up — keep trying.
questions.explanation: give up 意为「放弃」。
questions.zh: 别放弃，继续努力。

questions.content: The meeting was ___ off until next week.
questions.explanation: put off 意为「推迟」。
questions.zh: 会议被推迟到下周。

questions.content: She ___ after her mother.
questions.explanation: take after 意为「（外貌或性格）像（长辈）」。
questions.zh: 她长得像她妈妈。

questions.content: I'll ___ into the matter at once.
questions.explanation: look into 意为「调查」。
questions.zh: 我会立刻调查这件事。

questions.content: We ran ___ of petrol on the motorway.
questions.explanation: run out of 意为「用完」。
questions.zh: 我们在高速公路上没油了。

questions.content: The evidence is ___ to the case.
questions.explanation: be crucial to 意为「对……至关重要」，用形容词。
questions.zh: 证据对此案至关重要。

questions.content: He was reluctant to ___ responsibility.
questions.explanation: take responsibility 是固定搭配，意为「承担责任」。
questions.zh: 他不愿承担责任。

questions.content: The report ___ light on the causes of the failure.
questions.explanation: shed light on 意为「阐明、使……清楚」。
questions.zh: 这份报告阐明了失败的原因。

questions.content: We should ___ account of the risks.
questions.explanation: take account of 意为「考虑到」。
questions.zh: 我们应该把风险考虑进去。

questions.content: His argument doesn't ___ up to scrutiny.
questions.explanation: hold up to scrutiny 意为「经得起推敲」。
questions.zh: 他的论点经不起推敲。

questions.content: The two events are closely ___ .
questions.explanation: be related 意为「相关联」，用过去分词作形容词。
questions.zh: 这两个事件密切相关。

questions.content: She was ___ of the danger.
questions.explanation: be aware of 意为「意识到」。
questions.zh: 她意识到了危险。

questions.content: The plan is ___ to fail.
questions.explanation: be bound to do 意为「必定会」。
questions.zh: 这个计划注定失败。

questions.content: This is ___ to the previous discussion.
questions.explanation: be relevant to 意为「与……相关」。
questions.zh: 这与先前的讨论有关。

questions.content: He tends to ___ the point.
questions.explanation: miss the point 意为「没抓住要点」。
questions.zh: 他常常抓不住要点。

questions.content: The company is ___ a loss.
questions.explanation: make a loss 意为「亏损」。
questions.zh: 这家公司在亏损。

questions.content: We need to ___ the issue at its root.
questions.explanation: tackle an issue 意为「着手解决某个问题」，语气比 handle 更强调正面应对。
questions.zh: 我们需要从根源上解决这个问题。

questions.content: The findings ___ doubt on the theory.
questions.explanation: cast doubt on 意为「使人对……产生怀疑」。
questions.zh: 这些发现让人们对这一理论产生怀疑。

questions.content: She has a ___ for detail.
questions.explanation: have an eye for 意为「对……有鉴赏力、很敏感」。
questions.zh: 她对细节很敏感。

questions.content: The argument doesn't ___ water.
questions.explanation: hold water 意为「（论点）站得住脚」。
questions.zh: 这个论点站不住脚。

questions.content: The committee was ___ in its condemnation.
questions.explanation: be + 形容词作表语；unequivocal 意为「明确的、毫不含糊的」。
questions.zh: 委员会的谴责毫不含糊。

questions.content: The reforms were met with ___ resistance.
questions.explanation: stout resistance 意为「顽强的抵抗」，形容词修饰名词。
questions.zh: 改革遭到顽强抵抗。

questions.content: His remarks were ___ to the point of rudeness.
questions.explanation: be blunt to the point of... 意为「直率到……的地步」。
questions.zh: 他的话直率到近乎粗鲁。

questions.content: The proposal was ___ rejected.
questions.explanation: summarily 意为「即刻地、不加讨论地」，修饰 rejected。
questions.zh: 该提案被当即驳回。

questions.content: The two accounts are ___ irreconcilable.
questions.explanation: 修饰形容词 irreconcilable 用副词 mutually。
questions.zh: 这两种说法彼此无法调和。

questions.content: The evidence was ___ at best.
questions.explanation: circumstantial evidence 意为「间接证据」。
questions.zh: 这些证据充其量只是间接的。

questions.content: He was ___ to admit his error.
questions.explanation: be loath to do 意为「不情愿做」；loathe 是动词「厌恶」。
questions.zh: 他不愿意承认自己的错误。

questions.content: The policy had ___ effects on rural areas.
questions.explanation: deleterious 意为「有害的」，形容词修饰名词。
questions.zh: 该政策对农村地区产生了有害影响。

questions.content: The argument rests on a ___ premise.
questions.explanation: spurious 意为「站不住脚的、虚假的」。
questions.zh: 该论证建立在一个站不住脚的前提上。

questions.content: Her account of events was ___ with the facts.
questions.explanation: be consistent with 意为「与……一致」。
questions.zh: 她对事件的叙述与事实相符。

questions.content: This book is ___ .
questions.explanation: 名词性物主代词 mine 单独使用，后面不接名词。
questions.zh: 这本书是我的。

questions.content: Give the pen to ___ , please.
questions.explanation: 介词后接宾格 me。
questions.zh: 请把笔给我。

questions.content: ___ are my friends.
questions.explanation: 作主语用主格 They。
questions.zh: 他们是我的朋友。

questions.content: I like ___ new bike.
questions.explanation: 修饰名词用形容词性物主代词 his。
questions.zh: 我喜欢他的新自行车。

questions.content: She hurt ___ while cooking.
questions.explanation: 主语和宾语指同一人时用反身代词 herself。
questions.zh: 她做饭时伤到了自己。

questions.content: These shoes are ___ .
questions.explanation: 名词性物主代词 hers 独立使用。
questions.zh: 这双鞋是她的。

questions.content: I made this cake ___ .
questions.explanation: 强调「亲自」，用反身代词 myself。
questions.zh: 这个蛋糕是我自己做的。

questions.content: We enjoyed ___ at the party.
questions.explanation: enjoy oneself 是固定搭配，意为「玩得开心」。
questions.zh: 我们在聚会上玩得很开心。

questions.content: Help ___ to some fruit.
questions.explanation: help oneself to 意为「自便取用」。
questions.zh: 请随便吃点水果。

questions.content: ___ of the two answers is correct.
questions.explanation: neither of + 复数名词作主语，谓语用单数 is。
questions.zh: 两个答案都不对。

questions.content: I have two sisters. ___ of them is a doctor.
questions.explanation: each of + 复数名词，谓语用单数。
questions.zh: 我有两个姐姐，她们各自都是医生。

questions.content: There is ___ milk left.
questions.explanation: milk 不可数；a little 表示「还有一点」。
questions.zh: 还剩一点牛奶。

questions.content: ___ students passed the exam — only three.
questions.explanation: few 表示「几乎没有」，与 only three 呼应。
questions.zh: 几乎没有学生通过考试，只有三个。

questions.content: Is there ___ here who speaks French?
questions.explanation: 疑问句中用 anyone。
questions.zh: 这里有会说法语的人吗？

questions.content: ___ in the class knew the answer.
questions.explanation: 表示「所有人」用 everyone。
questions.zh: 班上每个人都知道答案。

questions.content: I'd like ___ else to help me.
questions.explanation: 肯定句中表示「某人」用 someone。
questions.zh: 我想要别人来帮我。

questions.content: ___ of the three options works.
questions.explanation: 三者及以上的否定用 none。
questions.zh: 三个选项都不行。

questions.content: The problem ___ is not difficult.
questions.explanation: 反身代词 itself 用于强调「本身」。
questions.zh: 这个问题本身并不难。

questions.content: They built the house ___ .
questions.explanation: 反身代词 themselves 强调「亲自」。
questions.zh: 他们自己盖了这座房子。

questions.content: This is not my umbrella; ___ is blue.
questions.explanation: 名词性物主代词 mine 作主语。
questions.zh: 这不是我的伞，我的是蓝色的。

questions.content: He is taller than ___ .
questions.explanation: 比较从句中作主语的代词用主格 I（口语中常用 me）。
questions.zh: 他比我高。

questions.content: The choice is between you and ___ .
questions.explanation: 介词 between 后用宾格 me。
questions.zh: 选择在你我之间。

questions.content: ___ you or your brother has to go.
questions.explanation: either... or 表示两者之一，谓语就近一致用单数。
questions.zh: 你或者你弟弟得去一个。

questions.content: The team congratulated ___ on the win.
questions.explanation: 主语 the team 视为整体，反身代词用 itself。
questions.zh: 球队为这场胜利自我祝贺。

questions.content: ___ of us had ever seen such a thing.
questions.explanation: none of us 表示「我们中没有一个」。
questions.zh: 我们谁也没见过这种事。

questions.content: He blamed ___ for the failure.
questions.explanation: 主语和宾语同指一人时用反身代词。
questions.zh: 他把失败归咎于自己。

questions.content: One should always be true to ___ .
questions.explanation: 主语 one 对应的反身代词是 oneself。
questions.zh: 人应当始终忠于自己。

questions.content: The book is ___ ; I bought it last year.
questions.explanation: 作表语的名词性物主代词用 mine。
questions.zh: 这本书是我的，我去年买的。

questions.content: ___ of the two roads leads to the village.
questions.explanation: either of + 复数名词，谓语用单数，表示「两者任一」。
questions.zh: 这两条路哪一条都通向村子。

questions.content: I have ___ to tell you.
questions.explanation: 肯定句中用 something。
questions.zh: 我有件事要告诉你。

questions.content: ___ who wants to come is welcome.
questions.explanation: anyone who... 表示「任何想……的人」。
questions.zh: 任何想来的人都欢迎。

questions.content: She is not ___ to blame.
questions.explanation: be not oneself 意为「状态不佳」，此处指她本人不在状态。
questions.zh: 她本人不在状态。

questions.content: We gave the prize to ___ won.
questions.explanation: whoever 在从句中作主语。
questions.zh: 我们把奖给了获胜的人。

questions.content: ___ he says should be taken seriously.
questions.explanation: whatever 引导主语从句，在从句中作 says 的宾语。
questions.zh: 他说的话都应当认真对待。

questions.content: The decision is ___ to make.
questions.explanation: 名词性物主代词 yours 作表语。
questions.zh: 这个决定由你来做。

questions.content: It is a problem of ___ own making.
questions.explanation: 形容词性物主代词 its 修饰 own making。
questions.zh: 这是它自己造成的问题。

questions.content: ___ of the candidates impressed the panel.
questions.explanation: neither of + 复数，谓语单数，表示两者都不。
questions.zh: 两位候选人都没给评审留下印象。

questions.content: He considers ___ indispensable to the team.
questions.explanation: 宾语与主语同指一人，用反身代词。
questions.zh: 他认为自己对团队不可或缺。

questions.content: ___ the outcome, we must remain calm.
questions.explanation: whatever + 名词，表示「无论……是什么」。
questions.zh: 无论结果如何，我们都必须保持冷静。

questions.content: The report is ___ , not mine.
questions.explanation: 名词性物主代词 hers 作表语。
questions.zh: 这份报告是她的，不是我的。

questions.content: ___ can be done has been done.
questions.explanation: all that 引导定语从句；不能说 all what。
questions.zh: 能做的都已经做了。

questions.content: They prided ___ on their efficiency.
questions.explanation: pride oneself on 意为「以……自豪」。
questions.zh: 他们以自己的高效率自豪。

questions.content: ___ is known to all, the earth is round.
questions.explanation: as is known to all 是固定结构，as 指代整个主句。
questions.zh: 众所周知，地球是圆的。

questions.content: I have nothing ___ to add.
questions.explanation: further 指「进一步的」（抽象）；farther 指距离更远。
questions.zh: 我没有别的要补充了。

questions.content: ___ of the two explanations is convincing.
questions.explanation: 两者都用 neither，不用 none。
questions.zh: 这两种解释都不能令人信服。

questions.content: He is not ___ today — he seems distracted.
questions.explanation: not oneself 意为「状态不佳」。
questions.zh: 他今天状态不佳，看起来心不在焉。

questions.content: ___ be the reason, the decision stands.
questions.explanation: whatever 引导让步状语从句，在从句中作表语。
questions.zh: 无论原因是什么，决定维持不变。

questions.content: The blame lies with ___ is responsible.
questions.explanation: whoever 在从句中作主语。
questions.zh: 责任在于该负责的人。

questions.content: They regarded the proposal as ___ unworkable.
questions.explanation: 强调「提案本身」，用反身代词。
questions.zh: 他们认为该提案本身就行不通。

questions.content: ___ else could have done it.
questions.explanation: no one else 意为「没有别人」。
questions.zh: 没有别人能做到。

questions.content: The results speak for ___ .
questions.explanation: speak for themselves 意为「本身就说明问题」。
questions.zh: 结果本身就说明问题。

questions.content: ___ of the arguments holds up.
questions.explanation: 三个及以上用 none。
questions.zh: 这些论点没有一个站得住脚。

questions.content: One cannot help but admire ___ .
questions.explanation: 此处 admire 的宾语指「他」而非主语 one，用宾格 him。
questions.zh: 人不由得佩服他。

questions.content: Such matters are best left to ___ .
questions.explanation: leave sth to sb，介词后用宾格 them。
questions.zh: 这类事情最好留给他们自己处理。

questions.content: ___ the consequences, she went ahead.
questions.explanation: whatever + 名词短语作让步状语。
questions.zh: 无论后果如何，她还是继续推进了。

questions.content: If it ___ tomorrow, we will stay at home.
questions.explanation: 条件状语从句中，用一般现在时表示将来。
questions.zh: 如果明天下雨，我们就待在家里。

questions.content: If I ___ more time, I would travel.
questions.explanation: 与现在事实相反的假设用过去式。
questions.zh: 如果我有更多时间，我就去旅行。

questions.content: If you heat ice, it ___ .
questions.explanation: 客观规律用零条件句，主从句都用一般现在时。
questions.zh: 加热冰，它就会融化。

questions.content: I will call you if I ___ any news.
questions.explanation: if 从句用一般现在时表将来。
questions.zh: 如果我有消息就给你打电话。

questions.content: Unless you hurry, you ___ the bus.
questions.explanation: unless 相当于 if... not，主句用将来时。
questions.zh: 除非你快点，否则你会赶不上公交车。

questions.content: If she ___ harder, she would pass.
questions.explanation: 与现在事实相反的第二条件句，从句用过去式。
questions.zh: 如果她更用功，她就能通过。

questions.content: If I ___ you, I would apologise.
questions.explanation: 虚拟语气中 be 动词统一用 were。
questions.zh: 如果我是你，我就道歉。

questions.content: You'll fail ___ you work harder.
questions.explanation: unless 意为「除非」。
questions.zh: 除非你更努力，否则你会失败。

questions.content: If he ___ late again, he'll be fired.
questions.explanation: if 从句用一般现在时表示将来。
questions.zh: 如果他再迟到，就会被解雇。

questions.content: If you don't water plants, they ___ .
questions.explanation: 零条件句表示普遍事实，主句用一般现在时。
questions.zh: 不浇水，植物就会死。

questions.content: If I ___ about the traffic, I would have left earlier.
questions.explanation: 与过去事实相反的第三条件句，从句用过去完成时。
questions.zh: 如果我当时知道会堵车，我就早点出发了。

questions.content: If she had studied, she ___ the exam.
questions.explanation: 第三条件句主句用 would have + 过去分词。
questions.zh: 如果她学过，她就能通过考试。

questions.content: I ___ have gone if you had asked me.
questions.explanation: 第三条件句主句用 would have done。
questions.zh: 如果你当时叫我，我就去了。

questions.content: If I were rich, I ___ buy a house.
questions.explanation: 第二条件句主句用 would + 动词原形。
questions.zh: 如果我有钱，我就买栋房子。

questions.content: ___ I had known, I would have told you.
questions.explanation: Had I known 是 If I had known 的倒装省略形式。
questions.zh: 我要是知道，就告诉你了。

questions.content: Should you ___ help, please call me.
questions.explanation: Should you need... 是 If you should need... 的倒装，动词用原形。
questions.zh: 如需帮助，请给我打电话。

questions.content: If I had more money, I ___ travel more.
questions.explanation: 第二条件句主句用 would。
questions.zh: 如果我有更多钱，我会多去旅行。

questions.content: You can borrow the car ___ you drive carefully.
questions.explanation: as long as 意为「只要」。
questions.zh: 只要你开车小心，就可以借这辆车。

questions.content: Take an umbrella ___ it rains.
questions.explanation: in case 后接从句，表示「以防」。
questions.zh: 带把伞，以防下雨。

questions.content: ___ it not for your help, I would have failed.
questions.explanation: Were it not for 是 If it were not for 的倒装。
questions.zh: 要不是你帮忙，我就失败了。

questions.content: If you ___ me earlier, I could have helped.
questions.explanation: 第三条件句从句用过去完成时。
questions.zh: 如果你早点告诉我，我就能帮忙了。

questions.content: If it ___ for the rain, we would have arrived on time.
questions.explanation: 与过去事实相反，用 had not been。
questions.zh: 要不是下雨，我们就准时到了。

questions.content: I'll help you ___ you ask me to.
questions.explanation: if 引导条件状语从句。
questions.zh: 只要你开口，我就会帮你。

questions.content: If we ___ earlier, we wouldn't be late now.
questions.explanation: 从句指过去，主句指现在，属混合条件句。
questions.zh: 如果我们早点出发，现在就不会迟到。

questions.content: ___ he come, tell him I'm out.
questions.explanation: Should he come 是 If he should come 的倒装，表示万一。
questions.zh: 万一他来了，就说我出去了。

questions.content: If I ___ you, I wouldn't do that.
questions.explanation: 虚拟语气中 be 动词用 were。
questions.zh: 如果我是你，我就不会那么做。

questions.content: Supposing he ___ , what would you do?
questions.explanation: supposing 引导虚拟条件，用过去式。
questions.zh: 假设他拒绝了，你会怎么办？

questions.content: If only I ___ taller!
questions.explanation: if only 表示强烈愿望，与现在事实相反用 were。
questions.zh: 我要是更高就好了！

questions.content: I would rather you ___ tomorrow.
questions.explanation: would rather 后接从句用过去式表虚拟。
questions.zh: 我宁愿你明天来。

questions.content: It's time we ___ a decision.
questions.explanation: It's time + 从句用过去式，表示「早该做了」。
questions.zh: 我们该做决定了。

questions.content: ___ for the delay, we would have been on time.
questions.explanation: but for 意为「要不是」，引导虚拟条件。
questions.zh: 要不是延误，我们本可以准时。

questions.content: If he ___ the offer, he would be working abroad now.
questions.explanation: 从句指过去，主句指现在，属混合条件句。
questions.zh: 如果他当时接受了这个提议，现在就在国外工作了。

questions.content: Had it not been for her support, he ___ .
questions.explanation: 第三条件句主句用 would have + 过去分词。
questions.zh: 要不是她的支持，他就失败了。

questions.content: ___ you change your mind, let me know.
questions.explanation: Should you change... 是条件句倒装，表示万一。
questions.zh: 万一你改变主意，告诉我一声。

questions.content: I wish I ___ the truth then.
questions.explanation: wish 后接与过去事实相反的虚拟，用过去完成时。
questions.zh: 我真希望当时知道真相。

questions.content: If only he ___ me what he was planning.
questions.explanation: if only 指过去，用过去完成时。
questions.zh: 他当时要是告诉我他的计划就好了。

questions.content: Suppose you ___ the lottery — what then?
questions.explanation: suppose 引导的假设句用过去式表示虚拟。
questions.zh: 假设你中了彩票，那又怎样？

questions.content: Were she ___ the offer, she would regret it.
questions.explanation: Were + 主语 + to do 是虚拟条件的倒装形式。
questions.zh: 她若拒绝这个提议，会后悔的。

questions.content: He acts as if he ___ everything.
questions.explanation: as if 引导与现在事实相反的虚拟，用过去式。
questions.zh: 他表现得好像什么都懂。

questions.content: You'd better take a map ___ you get lost.
questions.explanation: in case 后接从句，表示「以防」。
questions.zh: 你最好带张地图，以防迷路。

questions.content: If the plan ___ , we would have lost everything.
questions.explanation: 与过去事实相反，从句用过去完成时。
questions.zh: 如果计划当时失败了，我们就一无所有了。

questions.content: ___ I to be offered the job, I would accept.
questions.explanation: Were I to be offered... 是虚拟条件倒装。
questions.zh: 如果给我这份工作，我会接受。

questions.content: Unless the funding ___ , the project will be cancelled.
questions.explanation: unless 从句用一般现在时表将来。
questions.zh: 除非资金到位，否则项目将被取消。

questions.content: I wouldn't have said that if I ___ you.
questions.explanation: 与过去事实相反，从句用 had been。
questions.zh: 我要是你，就不会那么说。

questions.content: It would be better if you ___ me in advance.
questions.explanation: 与现在或将来的委婉虚拟用过去式。
questions.zh: 你事先告诉我会更好。

questions.content: ___ the opportunity to arise, he would seize it.
questions.explanation: Should the opportunity arise 是虚拟条件倒装，表示万一。
questions.zh: 万一机会出现，他会抓住。

questions.content: Had the warning been heeded, the disaster ___ avoided.
questions.explanation: 第三条件句被动式，用 would have been + 过去分词。
questions.zh: 如果当时听取了警告，这场灾难本可避免。

questions.content: Were it not for the subsidy, the scheme ___ unviable.
questions.explanation: Were it not for 指与现在事实相反，主句用 would be。
questions.zh: 要不是有补贴，这个方案根本不可行。

questions.content: But for her intervention, the deal ___ through.
questions.explanation: but for 指与过去事实相反，主句用 would have done。
questions.zh: 要不是她介入，这笔交易就黄了。

questions.content: ___ such a situation arise, we would need to act fast.
questions.explanation: Should such a situation arise 是倒装的虚拟条件句。
questions.zh: 万一出现这种情况，我们需要迅速行动。

questions.content: He talks as though he ___ the whole story.
questions.explanation: as though 引导与现在事实相反的虚拟，用过去式。
questions.zh: 他说话的口气好像他知道全部内情。

questions.content: If the data ___ more carefully, the error would have been caught.
questions.explanation: 与过去事实相反的被动虚拟，用 had been + 过去分词。
questions.zh: 如果当时更仔细地核查数据，这个错误就会被发现。

questions.content: I would rather he ___ the matter alone.
questions.explanation: would rather 后接从句用过去式表虚拟。
questions.zh: 我宁愿他独自处理这件事。

questions.content: ___ he to resign, the board would be in chaos.
questions.explanation: Were he to resign 是虚拟条件倒装。
questions.zh: 他要是辞职，董事会就会陷入混乱。

questions.content: Given more time, the team ___ a better solution.
questions.explanation: Given more time 隐含与过去事实相反的条件，主句用 would have done。
questions.zh: 如果时间更充裕，团队本可以找到更好的方案。

questions.content: I get up ___ seven o'clock.
questions.explanation: 具体时刻前用 at。
questions.zh: 我七点起床。

questions.content: We meet ___ Monday.
questions.explanation: 具体某一天前用 on。
questions.zh: 我们星期一见面。

questions.content: She was born ___ 1998.
questions.explanation: 年份前用 in。
questions.zh: 她出生于 1998 年。

questions.content: The book is ___ the table.
questions.explanation: 在物体表面上用 on。
questions.zh: 书在桌子上。

questions.content: He lives ___ Beijing.
questions.explanation: 在大城市或国家前用 in。
questions.zh: 他住在北京。

questions.content: I'm going ___ home.
questions.explanation: home 前不加介词，go home 是固定说法。
questions.zh: 我要回家了。

questions.content: The cat is ___ the box.
questions.explanation: 在容器内部用 in。
questions.zh: 猫在箱子里。

questions.content: She goes to school ___ bus.
questions.explanation: by + 交通工具，表示交通方式。
questions.zh: 她坐公交车上学。

questions.content: Wait ___ me here.
questions.explanation: wait for sb 是固定搭配。
questions.zh: 在这儿等我。

questions.content: This present is ___ you.
questions.explanation: for 表示「为了、给」。
questions.zh: 这个礼物是给你的。

questions.content: I'm good ___ maths.
questions.explanation: be good at 是固定搭配。
questions.zh: 我擅长数学。

questions.content: She's afraid ___ spiders.
questions.explanation: be afraid of 是固定搭配。
questions.zh: 她怕蜘蛛。

questions.content: I'm interested ___ history.
questions.explanation: be interested in 是固定搭配。
questions.zh: 我对历史感兴趣。

questions.content: He arrived ___ the airport at noon.
questions.explanation: arrive at 用于较小的地点，arrive in 用于城市或国家。
questions.zh: 他中午到了机场。

questions.content: They arrived ___ Japan yesterday.
questions.explanation: arrive in 用于城市、国家等较大范围。
questions.zh: 他们昨天到达日本。

questions.content: Thank you ___ your help.
questions.explanation: thank sb for sth 是固定搭配。
questions.zh: 谢谢你的帮助。

questions.content: She is married ___ a doctor.
questions.explanation: be married to sb 是固定搭配。
questions.zh: 她嫁给了一位医生。

questions.content: I'm looking forward ___ seeing you.
questions.explanation: look forward to 是固定搭配，to 是介词。
questions.zh: 我期待见到你。

questions.content: He's very different ___ his brother.
questions.explanation: be different from 是固定搭配。
questions.zh: 他和他哥哥很不一样。

questions.content: I spent two hours ___ my homework.
questions.explanation: spend time on sth 是固定搭配。
questions.zh: 我花了两个小时做作业。

questions.content: She is responsible ___ the budget.
questions.explanation: be responsible for 是固定搭配。
questions.zh: 她负责预算。

questions.content: We arrived ___ time for the film.
questions.explanation: in time 意为「及时」；on time 意为「准时」。
questions.zh: 我们及时赶上了电影。

questions.content: The train left ___ time.
questions.explanation: on time 意为「准时」。
questions.zh: 火车准点发车。

questions.content: She is very proud ___ her son.
questions.explanation: be proud of 是固定搭配。
questions.zh: 她为儿子感到非常骄傲。

questions.content: I agree ___ you on this point.
questions.explanation: agree with sb 表示同意某人。
questions.zh: 在这一点上我同意你。

questions.content: The decision depends ___ the weather.
questions.explanation: depend on 是固定搭配。
questions.zh: 这个决定取决于天气。

questions.content: He succeeded ___ passing the exam.
questions.explanation: succeed in doing sth 是固定搭配。
questions.zh: 他成功通过了考试。

questions.content: She insisted ___ paying.
questions.explanation: insist on doing sth 是固定搭配。
questions.zh: 她坚持要付钱。

questions.content: I'm not accustomed ___ getting up early.
questions.explanation: be accustomed to 中的 to 是介词，后接动名词。
questions.zh: 我不习惯早起。

questions.content: He was accused ___ stealing.
questions.explanation: be accused of 是固定搭配。
questions.zh: 他被指控偷窃。

questions.content: The film is based ___ a true story.
questions.explanation: be based on 是固定搭配。
questions.zh: 这部电影根据真实故事改编。

questions.content: She is capable ___ handling the job.
questions.explanation: be capable of doing 是固定搭配。
questions.zh: 她有能力胜任这份工作。

questions.content: We congratulated him ___ his promotion.
questions.explanation: congratulate sb on sth 是固定搭配。
questions.zh: 我们祝贺他升职。

questions.content: He suffers ___ severe headaches.
questions.explanation: suffer from 是固定搭配。
questions.zh: 他患有严重的头痛。

questions.content: I object ___ being treated like a child.
questions.explanation: object to 中的 to 是介词，后接动名词。
questions.zh: 我反对被当成小孩对待。

questions.content: The success resulted ___ months of work.
questions.explanation: result from 意为「由……导致」；result in 意为「导致」。
questions.zh: 这次成功源于数月的工作。

questions.content: The delay resulted ___ a lot of complaints.
questions.explanation: result in 意为「导致」。
questions.zh: 延误导致了大量投诉。

questions.content: She's keen ___ learning languages.
questions.explanation: be keen on 是固定搭配。
questions.zh: 她热衷于学习语言。

questions.content: He's not aware ___ the risks.
questions.explanation: be aware of 是固定搭配。
questions.zh: 他没有意识到风险。

questions.content: We must comply ___ the regulations.
questions.explanation: comply with 是固定搭配，意为「遵守」。
questions.zh: 我们必须遵守规定。

questions.content: The report is ___ line with our findings.
questions.explanation: in line with 意为「与……一致」。
questions.zh: 该报告与我们的发现一致。

questions.content: ___ the whole, the results were encouraging.
questions.explanation: on the whole 意为「总的来说」。
questions.zh: 总的来说，结果令人鼓舞。

questions.content: He did it ___ purpose to annoy me.
questions.explanation: on purpose 意为「故意地」。
questions.zh: 他故意那么做来惹我生气。

questions.content: The plan is still ___ discussion.
questions.explanation: under discussion 意为「在讨论中」。
questions.zh: 这个计划还在讨论中。

questions.content: ___ all accounts, the event was a success.
questions.explanation: by all accounts 意为「据大家所说」。
questions.zh: 据大家所说，这次活动很成功。

questions.content: She's ___ the verge of tears.
questions.explanation: on the verge of 意为「即将、濒于」。
questions.zh: 她快要哭了。

questions.content: The change came ___ effect last month.
questions.explanation: come into effect 意为「开始生效」。
questions.zh: 这项变更上月生效。

questions.content: He was ___ the impression that I agreed.
questions.explanation: be under the impression that 意为「误以为」。
questions.zh: 他误以为我同意了。

questions.content: The scheme was abandoned ___ grounds of cost.
questions.explanation: on the grounds of 意为「以……为理由」。
questions.zh: 该方案因成本原因被放弃。

questions.content: ___ no circumstances should you sign it.
questions.explanation: under no circumstances 意为「绝不」。
questions.zh: 任何情况下你都不该签字。

questions.content: The ruling runs counter ___ established practice.
questions.explanation: run counter to 意为「与……相悖」。
questions.zh: 该裁决与既有惯例相悖。

questions.content: The policy is ___ odds with public opinion.
questions.explanation: at odds with 意为「与……不一致」。
questions.zh: 该政策与民意相左。

questions.content: The findings are ___ variance with earlier data.
questions.explanation: at variance with 意为「与……不符」。
questions.zh: 这些发现与早先的数据不符。

questions.content: ___ the face of such evidence, denial is untenable.
questions.explanation: in the face of 意为「面对」。
questions.zh: 面对这样的证据，否认是站不住脚的。

questions.content: He acted ___ his own initiative.
questions.explanation: on one's own initiative 意为「主动地」。
questions.zh: 他是主动行事的。

questions.content: I enjoy ___ books.
questions.explanation: enjoy 后接动名词。
questions.zh: 我喜欢读书。

questions.content: She finished ___ her homework.
questions.explanation: finish 后接动名词。
questions.zh: 她做完了作业。

questions.content: Would you mind ___ the window?
questions.explanation: mind 后接动名词。
questions.zh: 你介意开一下窗吗？

questions.content: I want ___ a new phone.
questions.explanation: want 后接不定式。
questions.zh: 我想买一部新手机。

questions.content: He decided ___ early.
questions.explanation: decide 后接不定式。
questions.zh: 他决定早点离开。

questions.content: Stop ___ ! You're making noise.
questions.explanation: stop doing 意为「停止正在做的事」。
questions.zh: 别说话了！你在制造噪音。

questions.content: He stopped ___ a cigarette.
questions.explanation: stop to do 意为「停下来去做另一件事」。
questions.zh: 他停下来抽了根烟。

questions.content: Remember ___ the door when you leave.
questions.explanation: remember to do 意为「记得去做（还没做）」。
questions.zh: 离开时记得锁门。

questions.content: I remember ___ him somewhere.
questions.explanation: remember doing 意为「记得做过（已做）」。
questions.zh: 我记得在哪儿见过他。

questions.content: Try ___ more sleep.
questions.explanation: try to do 意为「努力去做」。
questions.zh: 试着多睡一会儿。

questions.content: I'm used to ___ up early.
questions.explanation: be used to 中的 to 是介词，后接动名词。
questions.zh: 我习惯早起。

questions.content: He used ___ in a factory.
questions.explanation: used to do 意为「过去常常做」。
questions.zh: 他过去在工厂工作。

questions.content: The machine needs ___ .
questions.explanation: need doing 表示被动含义，意为「需要被修理」。
questions.zh: 这台机器需要修理。

questions.content: I can't stand ___ in queues.
questions.explanation: can't stand 后接动名词。
questions.zh: 我受不了排队。

questions.content: She suggested ___ a taxi.
questions.explanation: suggest 后接动名词。
questions.zh: 她建议打车。

questions.content: He avoided ___ the question.
questions.explanation: avoid 后接动名词。
questions.zh: 他避开了这个问题。

questions.content: I'm looking forward to ___ you.
questions.explanation: look forward to 中的 to 是介词，后接动名词。
questions.zh: 我期待见到你。

questions.content: It's no use ___ him.
questions.explanation: It's no use 后接动名词。
questions.zh: 问他没用。

questions.content: He denied ___ anything.
questions.explanation: deny 后接动名词。
questions.zh: 他否认做过任何事。

questions.content: I'd like ___ the manager.
questions.explanation: would like 后接不定式。
questions.zh: 我想见经理。

questions.content: ___ is my favourite hobby.
questions.explanation: 动名词作主语表示一般性行为。
questions.zh: 游泳是我最喜欢的爱好。

questions.content: He apologised for ___ late.
questions.explanation: 介词 for 后接动名词。
questions.zh: 他为迟到道歉。

questions.content: Thank you for ___ me.
questions.explanation: 介词 for 后接动名词。
questions.zh: 谢谢你帮我。

questions.content: I'm thinking of ___ my job.
questions.explanation: 介词 of 后接动名词。
questions.zh: 我在考虑换工作。

questions.content: He kept ___ despite the noise.
questions.explanation: keep 后接动名词，表示持续做。
questions.zh: 尽管有噪音，他还是继续工作。

questions.content: We discussed ___ the office.
questions.explanation: discuss 后接动名词。
questions.zh: 我们讨论了搬迁办公室的事。

questions.content: She's afraid of ___ alone.
questions.explanation: 介词 of 后接动名词。
questions.zh: 她害怕独自旅行。

questions.content: I forgot ___ the letter.
questions.explanation: forget to do 意为「忘了去做（还没做）」。
questions.zh: 我忘了寄那封信。

questions.content: I'll never forget ___ Paris for the first time.
questions.explanation: forget doing 意为「忘记做过（已做）」。
questions.zh: 我永远不会忘记第一次去巴黎。

questions.content: They're interested in ___ a house.
questions.explanation: 介词 in 后接动名词。
questions.zh: 他们有意买房。

questions.content: The proposal is worth ___ .
questions.explanation: be worth 后接动名词，表示被动含义。
questions.zh: 这个提案值得考虑。

questions.content: He resented ___ for the mistake.
questions.explanation: resent 后接动名词；此处表被动，用 being done。
questions.zh: 他因这个错误被责备而感到不满。

questions.content: There's no point in ___ about it.
questions.explanation: There's no point in 后接动名词。
questions.zh: 为这件事担心没有意义。

questions.content: I can't help ___ at his jokes.
questions.explanation: can't help 后接动名词，意为「忍不住」。
questions.zh: 我忍不住被他的笑话逗笑。

questions.content: She objected to ___ the decision alone.
questions.explanation: object to 中的 to 是介词，后接动名词。
questions.zh: 她反对独自做这个决定。

questions.content: Having ___ the report, he went home.
questions.explanation: 完成式分词作状语，表示先于主句动作。
questions.zh: 写完报告后，他回家了。

questions.content: He admitted ___ the money.
questions.explanation: admit 后接动名词；表示更早发生用完成式 having done。
questions.zh: 他承认拿了那笔钱。

questions.content: The evidence is not worth ___ .
questions.explanation: be worth 后接动名词。
questions.zh: 这些证据不值得忽视。

questions.content: ___ the news, she burst into tears.
questions.explanation: 现在分词作时间状语，与主语是主动关系。
questions.zh: 听到这个消息，她哭了起来。

questions.content: I don't recall ___ him before.
questions.explanation: recall 后接动名词。
questions.zh: 我不记得以前见过他。

questions.content: You ___ swim here — it's dangerous.
questions.explanation: mustn't 表示禁止。
questions.zh: 你不能在这儿游泳，很危险。

questions.content: I ___ speak three languages.
questions.explanation: can 表示能力。
questions.zh: 我会说三种语言。

questions.content: ___ I open the window?
questions.explanation: May I...? 用于礼貌地请求许可。
questions.zh: 我可以开窗吗？

questions.content: You ___ see a doctor.
questions.explanation: should 表示建议。
questions.zh: 你应该去看医生。

questions.content: She ___ play the piano when she was six.
questions.explanation: could 是 can 的过去式，表示过去的能力。
questions.zh: 她六岁时就会弹钢琴。

questions.content: You ___ hurry — we have plenty of time.
questions.explanation: don't have to 表示「不必」，mustn't 表示「禁止」。
questions.zh: 你不必着急，我们时间很充裕。

questions.content: It ___ rain later. Take an umbrella.
questions.explanation: may 表示可能性。
questions.zh: 待会儿可能会下雨，带把伞。

questions.content: I ___ help you with that.
questions.explanation: will 表示主动提供帮助。
questions.zh: 我来帮你吧。

questions.content: Students ___ wear a uniform at this school.
questions.explanation: must 表示必须。
questions.zh: 这所学校的学生必须穿校服。

questions.content: ___ you pass me the salt, please?
questions.explanation: Could you...? 是礼貌的请求。
questions.zh: 你能把盐递给我吗？

questions.content: He ___ be at home — his car is outside.
questions.explanation: 有明确证据的肯定推测用 must。
questions.zh: 他一定在家，他的车在外面。

questions.content: She ___ be ill — she looks fine to me.
questions.explanation: 否定的肯定推测用 can't，表示「不可能」。
questions.zh: 她不可能生病，我看她挺好的。

questions.content: You ___ have told me! I was worried.
questions.explanation: should have done 表示「本应该做而没做」的责备。
questions.zh: 你本该告诉我的！我很担心。

questions.content: He ___ have missed the train — he's never late.
questions.explanation: can't have done 表示对过去的否定推测。
questions.zh: 他不可能错过火车，他从不迟到。

questions.content: They ___ have arrived by now.
questions.explanation: should have done 表示「按理说应该已经……」。
questions.zh: 他们现在应该已经到了。

questions.content: You ___ have waited — I had a key.
questions.explanation: needn't have done 表示「本不必做却做了」。
questions.zh: 你本不必等的，我有钥匙。

questions.content: ___ you mind closing the door?
questions.explanation: Would you mind doing...? 是礼貌的请求句式。
questions.zh: 你介意关一下门吗？

questions.content: I ___ rather stay at home tonight.
questions.explanation: would rather 意为「宁愿」。
questions.zh: 今晚我宁愿待在家里。

questions.content: You'd ___ take a coat.
questions.explanation: had better 意为「最好」，后接动词原形。
questions.zh: 你最好带件外套。

questions.content: She ___ not have known about the meeting.
questions.explanation: may not have done 表示对过去的不确定推测。
questions.zh: 她可能不知道有这个会议。

questions.content: ___ it be true? I can hardly believe it.
questions.explanation: Can it be...? 表示强烈的怀疑。
questions.zh: 这可能是真的吗？我几乎无法相信。

questions.content: You ___ have warned us earlier.
questions.explanation: could have done 表示「本可以做而没做」。
questions.zh: 你本可以早点提醒我们的。

questions.content: He ___ be working late — the light is still on.
questions.explanation: must be doing 表示对现在的肯定推测。
questions.zh: 他一定还在加班，灯还亮着。

questions.content: I ___ have left my keys at the office.
questions.explanation: must have done 表示对过去的肯定推测。
questions.zh: 我一定是把钥匙落在办公室了。

questions.content: There's no need to shout — I ___ hear you.
questions.explanation: can 表示能力。
questions.zh: 不用喊，我听得见。

questions.content: You ___ smoke in the building. It's illegal.
questions.explanation: mustn't 表示禁止。
questions.zh: 你不能在楼里吸烟，这是违法的。

questions.content: She ___ well have forgotten the appointment.
questions.explanation: may well 意为「很可能」。
questions.zh: 她很可能忘了这个约会。

questions.content: I ___ not have the time to finish this today.
questions.explanation: may not 表示「可能不」。
questions.zh: 我今天可能没时间完成这个。

questions.content: He ___ to have arrived by now.
questions.explanation: ought to have done 表示「按理应该已经……」。
questions.zh: 他现在按理应该已经到了。

questions.content: We ___ as well walk — it's not far.
questions.explanation: might as well 意为「不妨」。
questions.zh: 我们不妨走过去，路不远。

questions.content: You ___ have asked me — I would have helped.
questions.explanation: should have done 表示「本该做而没做」。
questions.zh: 你本该问我的，我会帮你。

questions.content: ___ he have forgotten our appointment?
questions.explanation: Can he have done...? 表示对过去的怀疑。
questions.zh: 他会是忘了我们的约会吗？

questions.content: The rules say visitors ___ report to reception.
questions.explanation: must 表示规定要求。
questions.zh: 规定要求访客必须到前台登记。

questions.content: I'd rather you ___ smoke in here.
questions.explanation: would rather 后接从句用过去式表虚拟。
questions.zh: 我宁愿你别在这儿抽烟。

questions.content: He ___ not have received the message.
questions.explanation: could not have done 表示「不可能已经……」。
questions.zh: 他不可能收到那条消息。

questions.content: ___ you have any questions, please ask.
questions.explanation: Should you have... 是虚拟条件的倒装。
questions.zh: 如有任何问题，请提问。

questions.content: The committee ___ to reach a decision by Friday.
questions.explanation: ought to 表示「应当」。
questions.zh: 委员会应当在周五前做出决定。

questions.content: He ___ have been more careful, but he wasn't.
questions.explanation: should have been 表示「本该更……而实际没有」。
questions.zh: 他本该更小心，但他没有。

questions.content: You ___ not have bothered — we'd already eaten.
questions.explanation: need not have done 表示「本不必做却做了」。
questions.zh: 你本不必费心的，我们已经吃过了。

questions.content: Such a claim ___ hardly be taken seriously.
questions.explanation: can hardly 意为「几乎不可能」。
questions.zh: 这样的说法几乎不可能被认真对待。

questions.content: He ___ well have been lying all along.
questions.explanation: may well have done 表示「很可能一直……」。
questions.zh: 他很可能一直在撒谎。

questions.content: I ___ have known better than to trust him.
questions.explanation: should have known better 意为「本该更明智」。
questions.zh: 我本该更明智，不该信他。

questions.content: They ___ to have finished by now.
questions.explanation: ought to have done 表示「按理应该已经完成」。
questions.zh: 他们按理现在应该已经完成了。

questions.content: You ___ as well tell him the truth.
questions.explanation: might as well 意为「不妨」。
questions.zh: 你不妨告诉他真相。

questions.content: The evidence ___ not support such a conclusion.
questions.explanation: 此处 does not support 是实义动词的否定，非情态动词。
questions.zh: 这些证据不支持这样的结论。

questions.content: ___ the need arise, we can mobilise extra staff.
questions.explanation: Should the need arise 是虚拟条件倒装，意为「万一有需要」。
questions.zh: 万一有需要，我们可以调集额外人手。

questions.content: He ___ have been expected to know the rules.
questions.explanation: could reasonably have been expected 表示「本可以合理地期待」，此处用 could。
questions.zh: 本可以合理地期待他了解这些规则。

questions.content: One ___ not underestimate the difficulty of the task.
questions.explanation: should not underestimate 表示「不应低估」。
questions.zh: 不应低估这项任务的难度。

questions.content: The report ___ to be treated with caution.
questions.explanation: ought to be treated 表示「应当被……对待」。
questions.zh: 这份报告应当谨慎对待。

questions.content: She ___ not have realised how serious it was.
questions.explanation: may not have realised 表示对过去的不确定推测。
questions.zh: 她可能没有意识到事情有多严重。

questions.content: ___ is your teacher?
questions.explanation: 询问人用 Who。
questions.zh: 你的老师是谁？

questions.content: ___ do you live?
questions.explanation: 询问地点用 Where。
questions.zh: 你住在哪里？

questions.content: ___ do you get up?
questions.explanation: 询问时间用 When。
questions.zh: 你什么时候起床？

questions.content: ___ are you crying?
questions.explanation: 询问原因用 Why。
questions.zh: 你为什么哭？

questions.content: ___ old is your sister?
questions.explanation: 询问年龄用 How old。
questions.zh: 你妹妹多大了？

questions.content: ___ book is this?
questions.explanation: 询问所属用 Whose。
questions.zh: 这是谁的书？

questions.content: ___ many students are there?
questions.explanation: 询问数量用 How many。
questions.zh: 有多少学生？

questions.content: ___ colour do you like?
questions.explanation: 在有限范围内选择用 Which。
questions.zh: 你喜欢哪种颜色？

questions.content: ___ you like coffee?
questions.explanation: 主语 you 的一般现在时疑问句用 Do。
questions.zh: 你喜欢咖啡吗？

questions.content: ___ she speak English?
questions.explanation: 主语 she 是第三人称单数，用 Does。
questions.zh: 她会说英语吗？

questions.content: ___ do you go to school? — By bike.
questions.explanation: 询问方式用 How。
questions.zh: 你怎么去上学？——骑自行车。

questions.content: ___ is the weather like today?
questions.explanation: 询问天气用 What is the weather like。
questions.zh: 今天天气怎么样？

questions.content: ___ far is the station from here?
questions.explanation: 询问距离用 How far。
questions.zh: 车站离这儿多远？

questions.content: ___ long does the journey take?
questions.explanation: 询问时长用 How long。
questions.zh: 这段旅程要多久？

questions.content: Could you tell me where ___ ?
questions.explanation: 宾语从句用陈述语序，不用疑问语序。
questions.zh: 你能告诉我银行在哪里吗？

questions.content: Do you know what time ___ ?
questions.explanation: 宾语从句用陈述语序。
questions.zh: 你知道现在几点吗？

questions.content: ___ you ever been to Paris?
questions.explanation: 现在完成时疑问句用 Have you ever been。
questions.zh: 你去过巴黎吗？

questions.content: ___ did you do last night?
questions.explanation: 询问做了什么事用 What。
questions.zh: 你昨晚做了什么？

questions.content: You're coming, ___ you?
questions.explanation: 反意疑问句：前肯后否，be 动词为 are。
questions.zh: 你会来的，对吧？

questions.content: She doesn't like fish, ___ she?
questions.explanation: 反意疑问句：前否后肯，助动词用 does。
questions.zh: 她不喜欢吃鱼，对吧？

questions.content: Let's go, ___ we?
questions.explanation: Let's 开头的反意疑问句用 shall we。
questions.zh: 我们走吧，好吗？

questions.content: Open the door, ___ you?
