questions.explanation: 祈使句的反意疑问句用 will you。
questions.zh: 把门打开，好吗？

questions.content: I'm right, ___ I?
questions.explanation: I am 的反意疑问句用 aren't I（口语惯用）。
questions.zh: 我说得对吧？

questions.content: Nobody came, ___ they?
questions.explanation: nobody 是否定词，反意疑问句用肯定式 did they。
questions.zh: 没人来，对吧？

questions.content: ___ you mind if I sat here?
questions.explanation: Would you mind if... 是礼貌的征询句式，从句用过去式。
questions.zh: 我坐这儿你介意吗？

questions.content: ___ happened to your car?
questions.explanation: 询问发生了什么事用 What。
questions.zh: 你的车怎么了？

questions.content: I wonder ___ he will accept.
questions.explanation: wonder if 表示「想知道是否」。
questions.zh: 我想知道他是否会接受。

questions.content: ___ do you think will win?
questions.explanation: do you think 是插入语，主语仍用主格 Who。
questions.zh: 你觉得谁会赢？

questions.content: Why ___ you tell me earlier?
questions.explanation: 询问过去没做的事用 didn't。
questions.zh: 你为什么不早点告诉我？

questions.content: ___ is it that makes you so sure?
questions.explanation: 强调句的特殊疑问形式 What is it that...。
questions.zh: 是什么让你如此确信？

questions.content: Have you any idea ___ he went?
questions.explanation: 宾语从句用 where 引导，语序为陈述语序。
questions.zh: 你知道他去哪儿了吗？

questions.content: ___ it rain yesterday?
questions.explanation: 一般过去时疑问句用 Did。
questions.zh: 昨天下雨了吗？

questions.content: Do you know ___ the meeting starts?
questions.explanation: 宾语从句用 when 引导，后面接陈述语序。
questions.zh: 你知道会议什么时候开始吗？

questions.content: ___ of these two do you prefer?
questions.explanation: 在两者中选择用 Which。
questions.zh: 这两个你更喜欢哪一个？

questions.content: You haven't seen him, ___ you?
questions.explanation: 前否后肯，助动词用 have。
questions.zh: 你没见过他，对吧？

questions.content: ___ was it that first attracted you to the job?
questions.explanation: 强调句的特殊疑问形式。
questions.zh: 最初吸引你做这份工作的是什么？

questions.content: Not only did he apologise, ___ he also refunded the fee.
questions.explanation: not only... but also... 是固定搭配。
questions.zh: 他不仅道了歉，还退还了费用。

questions.content: Little did she know ___ awaited her.
questions.explanation: what 引导宾语从句，在从句中作主语。
questions.zh: 她几乎不知道等待她的是什么。

questions.content: Could you clarify ___ the figures were calculated?
questions.explanation: 询问方式用 how 引导宾语从句。
questions.zh: 你能说明一下这些数字是如何计算的吗？

questions.content: He asked ___ I had finished the report.
questions.explanation: 间接引语中的一般疑问句用 whether 或 if。
questions.zh: 他问我是否完成了报告。

questions.content: ___ do you account for the discrepancy?
questions.explanation: how do you account for 意为「你如何解释」。
questions.zh: 你如何解释这个差异？

questions.content: ___ is to blame for the delay?
questions.explanation: 作主语用主格 Who。
questions.zh: 延误该由谁负责？

questions.content: ___ the committee reached a decision remains unclear.
questions.explanation: 主语从句表示「是否」用 whether，不用 if。
questions.zh: 委员会是否达成决定仍不清楚。

questions.content: You did tell him, ___ you?
questions.explanation: 前肯后否，助动词用 didn't。
questions.zh: 你确实告诉他了，对吧？

questions.content: ___ reason did he give for resigning?
questions.explanation: what reason 作 give 的宾语，用 What。
questions.zh: 他给出的辞职理由是什么？

questions.content: ___ is it that the policy fails to address?
questions.explanation: 强调句的特殊疑问形式，what 作 address 的宾语。
questions.zh: 这项政策未能解决的是什么？

questions.content: Hardly had the announcement been made ___ questions began.
questions.explanation: hardly... when 是固定搭配。
questions.zh: 公告刚一发布，提问就开始了。

questions.content: ___ you to change one thing, what would it be?
questions.explanation: Were you to change... 是虚拟条件倒装。
questions.zh: 如果你能改变一件事，那会是什么？

questions.content: The question ___ whether the evidence is admissible.
questions.explanation: 主语 the question 单数，谓语用 is。
questions.zh: 问题在于证据是否可采。

questions.content: ___ was it that alerted you to the problem?
questions.explanation: 强调句的特殊疑问形式。
questions.zh: 是什么让你注意到了这个问题？

questions.content: The letter ___ yesterday.
questions.explanation: 过去被动语态用 was/were + 过去分词。
questions.zh: 这封信昨天被寄出了。

questions.content: English ___ all over the world.
questions.explanation: 一般现在时被动语态用 is/are + 过去分词。
questions.zh: 全世界都在说英语。

questions.content: The bridge ___ next year.
questions.explanation: 将来被动语态用 will be + 过去分词。
questions.zh: 这座桥明年建成。

questions.content: This song ___ by the Beatles.
questions.explanation: write 的过去分词是 written。
questions.zh: 这首歌是披头士写的。

questions.content: The rooms ___ every day.
questions.explanation: 一般现在时被动语态，主语复数用 are + 过去分词。
questions.zh: 房间每天打扫。

questions.content: My car ___ last week.
questions.explanation: 过去被动语态用 was + 过去分词。
questions.zh: 我的车上周被偷了。

questions.content: The homework ___ tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 将来被动语态用 will be + 过去分词。
questions.zh: 作业明天检查。

questions.content: These books ___ in China.
questions.explanation: 一般现在时被动语态。
questions.zh: 这些书在中国印刷。

questions.content: The window ___ by the boys.
questions.explanation: 过去被动语态用 was + 过去分词。
questions.zh: 窗户被那些男孩打破了。

questions.content: Dinner ___ at seven.
questions.explanation: 一般现在时被动语态。
questions.zh: 晚餐七点供应。

questions.content: The report ___ by the manager right now.
questions.explanation: 现在进行时被动语态用 is being + 过去分词。
questions.zh: 报告正在由经理撰写。

questions.content: The streets ___ cleaned every morning.
questions.explanation: 主语 the streets 复数，一般现在时被动语态用 are。
questions.zh: 街道每天早上清扫。

questions.content: The work ___ by Friday.
questions.explanation: 情态动词的被动语态用 must be + 过去分词。
questions.zh: 这项工作必须在周五前完成。

questions.content: This problem can ___ easily.
questions.explanation: 情态动词 can 后接被动不定式 be + 过去分词。
questions.zh: 这个问题很容易解决。

questions.content: The letter ___ yet.
questions.explanation: 现在完成时被动语态用 has/have been + 过去分词。
questions.zh: 这封信还没寄出。

questions.content: He ___ to be a genius.
questions.explanation: It is said that he... 的被动转换。
questions.zh: 据说他是个天才。

questions.content: The tickets ___ out already.
questions.explanation: 现在完成时被动语态。
questions.zh: 票已经卖光了。

questions.content: I ___ to the party last night.
questions.explanation: 过去被动语态。
questions.zh: 我昨晚被邀请参加聚会。

questions.content: The road ___ at the moment.
questions.explanation: 现在进行时被动语态。
questions.zh: 这条路正在维修。

questions.content: Such mistakes ___ be avoided.
questions.explanation: 情态动词被动语态 can be + 过去分词。
questions.zh: 这类错误是可以避免的。

questions.content: She ___ the news yesterday.
questions.explanation: tell 的过去被动语态为 was told。
questions.zh: 她昨天被告知了这个消息。

questions.content: The building ___ in 1920.
questions.explanation: 过去被动语态。
questions.zh: 这座建筑建于 1920 年。

questions.content: The results ___ tomorrow morning.
questions.explanation: 将来被动语态。
questions.zh: 结果将于明天上午公布。

questions.content: The car needs ___ .
questions.explanation: need doing 表示被动含义。
questions.zh: 这辆车需要洗。

questions.content: He is believed ___ abroad.
questions.explanation: be believed to do 是固定结构。
questions.zh: 据信他住在国外。

questions.content: The proposal ___ by the board next month.
questions.explanation: 将来被动语态。
questions.zh: 该提案将于下月由董事会审议。

questions.content: He ___ to have left the country.
questions.explanation: It is reported that... 的被动转换。
questions.zh: 据报道他已离开该国。

questions.content: The findings ___ widely cited since publication.
questions.explanation: since + 时间点，现在完成时被动语态。
questions.zh: 这些发现自发表以来被广泛引用。

questions.content: Nothing ___ about the incident since then.
questions.explanation: 现在完成时被动语态。
questions.zh: 自那以后关于此事再没说什么。

questions.content: The data ___ before conclusions were drawn.
questions.explanation: data 作复数，过去被动语态用 were + 过去分词。
questions.zh: 在得出结论前数据已核实。

questions.content: The manuscript is said ___ in the twelfth century.
questions.explanation: 不定式完成被动式表示先于谓语发生的被动动作。
questions.zh: 据说这份手稿写于十二世纪。

questions.content: The issue ___ at the next meeting.
questions.explanation: 将来被动语态。
questions.zh: 这个问题将在下次会议上讨论。

questions.content: He dislikes ___ waiting.
questions.explanation: dislike 后接动名词；表被动用 being done。
questions.zh: 他讨厌让别人等着。

questions.content: The policy ___ effect last month.
questions.explanation: come into effect 是主动语态的固定搭配。
questions.zh: 该政策上月生效。

questions.content: Such behaviour ___ not be tolerated.
questions.explanation: 此处 not be tolerated 前已有情态动词 should，构成 should not be tolerated。
questions.zh: 这种行为不应被容忍。

questions.content: The theory ___ to have been superseded.
questions.explanation: appear 是不及物动词，不用被动；后接不定式完成被动式。
questions.zh: 这一理论似乎已被取代。

questions.content: The reforms ___ by considerable opposition.
questions.explanation: 主语 the reforms 复数，过去被动语态用 were met。
questions.zh: 改革遭到相当大的反对。

questions.content: Not a single objection ___ raised.
questions.explanation: 主语 a single objection 单数，用 was。
questions.zh: 没有提出任何异议。

questions.content: The decision ___ to be final.
questions.explanation: be understood to be 意为「据理解为」。
questions.zh: 该决定据理解为最终决定。

questions.content: Measures ___ to address the shortfall.
questions.explanation: 现在进行时被动语态，主语复数用 are being + 过去分词。
questions.zh: 正在采取措施应对缺口。

questions.content: The report ___ widely criticised at the time.
questions.explanation: 主语 the report 单数，过去被动语态用 was。
questions.zh: 这份报告当时受到广泛批评。

questions.content: Little ___ about the causes of the collapse.
questions.explanation: little 置于句首，被动语态 is known。
questions.zh: 关于崩塌的原因所知甚少。

questions.content: The findings ___ to be treated with caution.
questions.explanation: ought to be + 过去分词构成被动。
questions.zh: 这些发现应当谨慎对待。

questions.content: He resented ___ to justify his actions.
questions.explanation: resent 后接动名词；表被动用 being done。
questions.zh: 他讨厌被要求为自己的行为辩解。

questions.content: The scheme ___ to have been a failure.
questions.explanation: prove 在此作系动词，不用被动。
questions.zh: 这个方案被证明是失败的。

questions.content: The evidence must ___ before any ruling.
questions.explanation: 情态动词后接被动不定式。
questions.zh: 在做出任何裁定前必须审查证据。

questions.content: The manuscript ___ missing for a century.
questions.explanation: for + 时间段，现在完成时用 has been。
questions.zh: 这份手稿已失踪一个世纪。

questions.content: The proposal was ___ by the committee.
questions.explanation: turn down 意为「否决」，被动式为 was turned down。
questions.zh: 该提案被委员会否决了。

questions.content: Such claims ___ be substantiated.
questions.explanation: 情态动词被动语态 cannot be + 过去分词。
questions.zh: 这类说法无法被证实。

questions.content: The results ___ to the participants afterwards.
questions.explanation: 主语 the results 复数，过去被动语态用 were。
questions.zh: 结果事后向参与者披露。

questions.content: He said he ___ tired.
questions.explanation: 主句为过去时，间接引语从句时态相应后退。
questions.zh: 他说他累了。

questions.content: She said she ___ the film the day before.
questions.explanation: 引语中「昨天」转为 the day before，时态用过去完成时。
questions.zh: 她说她前一天看过那部电影。

questions.content: He told me he ___ come the next day.
questions.explanation: will 在间接引语中变为 would。
questions.zh: 他告诉我他第二天会来。

questions.content: She asked me ___ I was busy.
questions.explanation: 一般疑问句转间接引语用 if 或 whether。
questions.zh: 她问我是否忙。

questions.content: He asked me where I ___ .
questions.explanation: 间接引语中从句时态后退，且用陈述语序。
questions.zh: 他问我住在哪里。

questions.content: She said she ___ finished the report.
questions.explanation: 现在完成时在间接引语中变为过去完成时。
questions.zh: 她说她已经完成了报告。

questions.content: He told us he ___ been waiting for an hour.
questions.explanation: 现在完成进行时在间接引语中变为过去完成进行时。
questions.zh: 他告诉我们他已经等了一个小时。

questions.content: She said she ___ to the party that night.
questions.explanation: 现在进行时在间接引语中变为过去进行时。
questions.zh: 她说她那天晚上要去参加聚会。

questions.content: He asked what time the train ___ .
questions.explanation: 间接引语中从句时态随主句后退。
questions.zh: 他问火车几点开。

questions.content: She told me she ___ the keys on the table.
questions.explanation: 一般现在时在间接引语中变为一般过去时。
questions.zh: 她告诉我她把钥匙放在桌上了。

questions.content: He said he ___ help me later.
questions.explanation: will 变为 would。
questions.zh: 他说他稍后会帮我。

questions.content: She said she ___ swim when she was five.
questions.explanation: can 在间接引语中变为 could。
questions.zh: 她说她五岁时就会游泳。

questions.content: He asked me ___ I had seen his wallet.
questions.explanation: 一般疑问句用 if 引导。
questions.zh: 他问我有没有看到他的钱包。

questions.content: She said she ___ rather stay at home.
questions.explanation: would rather 在间接引语中不变。
questions.zh: 她说她宁愿待在家里。

questions.content: He told me he ___ never been abroad.
questions.explanation: 现在完成时变为过去完成时。
questions.zh: 他告诉我他从没出过国。

questions.content: She said, "I am busy." → She said she ___ busy.
questions.explanation: am 在间接引语中变为 was。
questions.zh: 她说她很忙。

questions.content: He asked me ___ I could help him.
questions.explanation: 请求转述用 ask + if。
questions.zh: 他问我能否帮他。

questions.content: She told him ___ quiet.
questions.explanation: 祈使句转述用 tell sb to do sth。
questions.zh: 她让他安静。

questions.content: He asked me ___ leave the door open.
questions.explanation: 否定祈使句转述用 ask sb not to do。
questions.zh: 他让我别把门开着。

questions.content: She said she ___ seen him the previous week.
questions.explanation: 「上周」转述为 the previous week，时态用过去完成时。
questions.zh: 她说她前一周见过他。

questions.content: He said he would have finished if he ___ more time.
questions.explanation: 第三条件句在间接引语中，从句用过去完成时。
questions.zh: 他说如果时间更多他就完成了。

questions.content: She asked whether we ___ the documents.
questions.explanation: 间接引语中从句时态后退为过去完成时。
questions.zh: 她问我们是否收到了文件。

questions.content: He admitted he ___ the money.
questions.explanation: 表示更早发生的动作，用过去完成时。
questions.zh: 他承认拿了那笔钱。

questions.content: She promised she ___ on time.
questions.explanation: promise 后接 would 表示过去的将来。
questions.zh: 她保证会准时。

questions.content: He warned us ___ too close to the edge.
questions.explanation: warn sb not to do sth 是固定结构。
questions.zh: 他警告我们别靠边缘太近。

questions.content: She suggested that we ___ the meeting.
questions.explanation: suggest that 后接虚拟语气，用动词原形。
questions.zh: 她建议我们推迟会议。

questions.content: He insisted that she ___ present.
questions.explanation: insist that 后接虚拟语气 be。
questions.zh: 他坚持要她到场。

questions.content: They claimed they ___ the work themselves.
questions.explanation: claim 后接过去完成时，表示先于主句动作。
questions.zh: 他们声称是他们自己完成了这项工作。

questions.content: He denied that he ___ involved.
questions.explanation: deny that 后从句时态后退。
questions.zh: 他否认自己曾参与其中。

questions.content: She explained that the delay ___ unavoidable.
questions.explanation: 间接引语中时态后退。
questions.zh: 她解释说延误是不可避免的。

questions.content: He told me he ___ the report by then.
questions.explanation: by then 表示过去的将来某时之前，用 would have done。
questions.zh: 他告诉我到那时他已经完成报告了。

questions.content: She asked me how long I ___ there.
questions.explanation: 过去完成进行时表示持续到过去某时点的动作。
questions.zh: 她问我在那儿工作多久了。

questions.content: He advised me ___ the offer.
questions.explanation: advise sb to do sth 是固定结构。
questions.zh: 他建议我接受这个提议。

questions.content: They announced that the results ___ later.
questions.explanation: 过去的将来被动语态用 would be + 过去分词。
questions.zh: 他们宣布结果将在稍后公布。

questions.content: He complained that he ___ enough time.
questions.explanation: 间接引语中时态后退为过去式。
questions.zh: 他抱怨说他没有足够时间。

questions.content: She told me she ___ the letter that morning.
questions.explanation: 「今天早上」转述为 that morning，时态用过去完成时。
questions.zh: 她告诉我她那天早上把信寄出了。

questions.content: He asked me ___ I had any experience.
questions.explanation: 一般疑问句转述用 whether 或 if。
questions.zh: 他问我是否有经验。

questions.content: She said she ___ rather not discuss it.
questions.explanation: would rather 保持不变。
questions.zh: 她说她宁愿不讨论这件事。

questions.content: He offered ___ me to the airport.
questions.explanation: offer to do sth 是固定结构。
questions.zh: 他主动提出开车送我去机场。

questions.content: They refused ___ the terms.
questions.explanation: refuse to do sth 是固定结构。
questions.zh: 他们拒绝接受这些条件。

questions.content: She is a very ___ girl.
questions.explanation: 修饰名词用形容词 beautiful。
questions.zh: 她是个很漂亮的女孩。

questions.content: This is an ___ book.
questions.explanation: 修饰物用 -ing 形式的形容词。
questions.zh: 这是本有趣的书。

questions.content: I was ___ to hear the news.
questions.explanation: 人作主语描述感受用 -ed 形式。
questions.zh: 听到这个消息我很惊讶。

questions.content: The weather is very ___ today.
questions.explanation: 作表语用形容词 cold。
questions.zh: 今天天气很冷。

questions.content: He is ___ than his brother.
questions.explanation: than 前用比较级。
questions.zh: 他比他哥哥高。

questions.content: This is the ___ building in the city.
questions.explanation: the + 最高级表示在范围内最……。
questions.zh: 这是城里最高的建筑。

questions.content: The film was ___ than I expected.
questions.explanation: good 的比较级是 better。
questions.zh: 这部电影比我预期的好。

questions.content: This is the ___ mistake I have ever made.
questions.explanation: bad 的最高级是 worst。
questions.zh: 这是我犯过最严重的错误。

questions.content: She is as ___ as her sister.
questions.explanation: as... as 之间用原级。
questions.zh: 她和她姐姐一样高。

questions.content: This exercise is ___ than the last one.
questions.explanation: easy 的比较级是 easier。
questions.zh: 这个练习比上一个容易。

questions.content: The room is not big ___ for six people.
questions.explanation: enough 放在形容词之后。
questions.zh: 这个房间不够六个人住。

questions.content: The soup is too ___ to drink.
questions.explanation: too + 形容词 + to do 结构。
questions.zh: 这汤太烫了，喝不了。

questions.content: He is ___ to reach the top shelf.
questions.explanation: enough 修饰形容词时后置。
questions.zh: 他够高，能够到最上面那层架子。

questions.content: This is a ___ problem.
questions.explanation: 修饰名词用形容词。
questions.zh: 这是个严重的问题。

questions.content: The film was so ___ that I fell asleep.
questions.explanation: 修饰物（the film）用 -ing 形式。
questions.zh: 这部电影太无聊了，我睡着了。

questions.content: The two options are equally ___ .
questions.explanation: 作表语用形容词 attractive。
questions.zh: 这两个选项同样有吸引力。

questions.content: He was ___ of the risk involved.
questions.explanation: be unaware of 意为「未意识到」。
questions.zh: 他没有意识到其中的风险。

questions.content: Timing is ___ in this negotiation.
questions.explanation: 作表语用形容词 crucial，意为「至关重要的」。
questions.zh: 在这场谈判中时机至关重要。

questions.content: The results were ___ with our expectations.
questions.explanation: be consistent with 意为「与……一致」。
questions.zh: 结果与我们的预期一致。

questions.content: This is a ___ opportunity we cannot miss.
questions.explanation: 修饰名词用形容词 rare。
questions.zh: 这是个不能错过的难得机会。

questions.content: The more you read, the ___ your vocabulary becomes.
questions.explanation: the more... the + 比较级 结构。
questions.zh: 读得越多，词汇量越丰富。

questions.content: He is ___ of his achievements.
questions.explanation: be proud of 意为「为……自豪」。
questions.zh: 他为自己的成就感到自豪。

questions.content: She is ___ at dealing with complaints.
questions.explanation: be good at 意为「擅长」。
questions.zh: 她擅长处理投诉。

questions.content: The weather was ___ than we had hoped.
questions.explanation: bad 的比较级是 worse。
questions.zh: 天气比我们期望的差。

questions.content: This is the ___ solution available.
questions.explanation: the + 最高级，simple 的最高级是 simplest。
questions.zh: 这是目前可用的最简单的方案。

questions.content: He is ___ to criticism.
questions.explanation: be sensitive to 意为「对……敏感」。
questions.zh: 他对批评很敏感。

questions.content: The proposal is ___ to the one we rejected.
questions.explanation: be similar to 意为「与……相似」。
questions.zh: 这个提案与我们否决过的那个相似。

questions.content: The findings are ___ with previous research.
questions.explanation: be consistent with 意为「与……一致」。
questions.zh: 这些发现与先前研究一致。

questions.content: He was ___ to admit his mistake.
questions.explanation: be reluctant to do 意为「不情愿做」。
questions.zh: 他不愿承认自己的错误。

questions.content: The evidence is ___ from conclusive.
questions.explanation: far from conclusive 意为「远非定论」。
questions.zh: 这些证据远非定论。

questions.content: The two theories are mutually ___ .
questions.explanation: mutually exclusive 意为「互相排斥的」。
questions.zh: 这两种理论互相排斥。

questions.content: The results are ___ to interpretation.
questions.explanation: be open to interpretation 意为「可以有多种解读」。
questions.zh: 这些结果可以有多种解读。

questions.content: She was ___ about the outcome.
questions.explanation: be optimistic about 意为「对……乐观」。
questions.zh: 她对结果很乐观。

questions.content: The problem is far more ___ than it appears.
questions.explanation: more + 形容词原级构成比较级。
questions.zh: 这个问题远比表面看起来复杂。

questions.content: He is ___ of taking risks.
questions.explanation: be capable of doing 意为「有能力做」。
questions.zh: 他有能力承担风险。

questions.content: The data is ___ to error.
questions.explanation: be prone to 意为「易于……的」。
questions.zh: 这些数据容易出现误差。

questions.content: The claim is ___ of scrutiny.
questions.explanation: be worthy of 意为「值得」。
questions.zh: 这一说法经得起推敲。

questions.content: The outcome was ___ from what we predicted.
questions.explanation: be different from 意为「与……不同」。
questions.zh: 结果与我们的预测不同。

questions.content: He was ___ for the position.
questions.explanation: ineligible for 意为「没有资格……的」。
questions.zh: 他没有资格担任这个职位。

questions.content: The report is ___ of serious errors.
questions.explanation: be free of 意为「没有、不含」。
questions.zh: 这份报告没有严重错误。

questions.content: The ___ are playing outside.
questions.explanation: child 的复数是不规则形式 children。
questions.zh: 孩子们在外面玩。

questions.content: There are three ___ in the room.
questions.explanation: woman 的复数是 women。
questions.zh: 房间里有三个女人。

questions.content: I need some ___ .
questions.explanation: bread 是不可数名词。
questions.zh: 我需要一些面包。

questions.content: She gave me two ___ of advice.
questions.explanation: 不可数名词用量词计量：two pieces of advice。
questions.zh: 她给了我两条建议。

questions.content: My ___ are in the drawer.
questions.explanation: key 的复数直接加 -s。
questions.zh: 我的钥匙在抽屉里。

questions.content: They bought a lot of new ___ last month.
questions.explanation: furniture 是不可数名词。
questions.zh: 他们上个月买了很多新家具。

questions.content: He gave me some useful ___ .
questions.explanation: advice 不可数，没有复数形式。
questions.zh: 他给了我一些有用的建议。

questions.content: Could you give me some ___ ?
questions.explanation: information 是不可数名词。
questions.zh: 你能给我一些信息吗？

questions.content: The ___ is nice today.
questions.explanation: weather 是不可数名词。
questions.zh: 今天天气不错。

questions.content: She has made great ___ .
questions.explanation: progress 不可数，make progress 意为「取得进步」。
questions.zh: 她取得了很大进步。

questions.content: There are two ___ of milk in the fridge.
questions.explanation: 不可数名词用容器量词计量。
questions.zh: 冰箱里有两瓶牛奶。

questions.content: My ___ hurts.
questions.explanation: tooth 的复数是 teeth；此处作主语指多颗牙。
questions.zh: 我的牙疼。

questions.content: The ___ are playing in the garden.
questions.explanation: children 本身已是复数形式。
questions.zh: 孩子们在花园里玩。

questions.content: I bought two ___ of shoes.
questions.explanation: a pair of shoes 的复数是 pairs of shoes。
questions.zh: 我买了两双鞋。

questions.content: There is some ___ on the floor.
questions.explanation: paper 作「纸」解时不可数。
questions.zh: 地上有一些纸。

questions.content: The ___ of the two plans is unclear.
questions.explanation: 冠词 the 后需要名词 difference。
questions.zh: 这两个计划的区别不清楚。

questions.content: His ___ to the proposal was unexpected.
questions.explanation: 形容词性物主代词后接名词 objection。
questions.zh: 他对这个提案的反对出人意料。

questions.content: The company reported a sharp ___ in profits.
questions.explanation: a sharp + 名词，用 decline。
questions.zh: 公司报告利润大幅下降。

questions.content: There has been a marked ___ in crime.
questions.explanation: a marked + 名词，用 reduction。
questions.zh: 犯罪率明显下降。

questions.content: Her ___ of the situation was accurate.
questions.explanation: 形容词性物主代词后接名词。
questions.zh: 她对形势的判断是准确的。

questions.content: The ___ of the results surprised everyone.
questions.explanation: 冠词 the 后需要名词 accuracy。
questions.zh: 结果的准确性让所有人惊讶。

questions.content: We need to reach an ___ on the price.
questions.explanation: an + 名词 agreement。
questions.zh: 我们需要在价格上达成一致。

questions.content: The ___ of the two theories is striking.
questions.explanation: the + 名词 similarity。
questions.zh: 这两种理论的相似之处很显著。

questions.content: His ___ for the job was rejected.
questions.explanation: 形容词性物主代词后接名词 application。
questions.zh: 他这份工作的申请被拒了。

questions.content: The ___ of the evidence was questioned.
questions.explanation: the + 名词 reliability。
questions.zh: 证据的可靠性受到质疑。

questions.content: The ___ of the findings is disputed.
questions.explanation: the + 名词 interpretation。
questions.zh: 这些发现的解读存在争议。

questions.content: There is little ___ of a recovery.
questions.explanation: little 修饰不可数名词 prospect，表示「可能性」。
questions.zh: 复苏的可能性很小。

questions.content: The ___ of the policy remains unclear.
questions.explanation: the + 名词 implementation。
questions.zh: 该政策的落实仍不清楚。

questions.content: He has considerable ___ in the field.
questions.explanation: 不可数名词 expertise 意为「专业知识」。
questions.zh: 他在这一领域有相当的专业知识。

questions.content: The ___ between the two is significant.
questions.explanation: the + 名词 distinction。
questions.zh: 两者的区别很显著。

questions.content: The ___ of the project is uncertain.
questions.explanation: the + 名词 viability。
questions.zh: 这个项目的可行性不确定。

questions.content: There has been a ___ in demand.
questions.explanation: a + 名词 shift。
questions.zh: 需求出现了转变。

questions.content: The ___ of the data took weeks.
questions.explanation: the + 名词 analysis。
questions.zh: 数据分析花了好几周。

questions.content: His ___ of the argument was persuasive.
questions.explanation: 形容词性物主代词后接名词 refutation。
questions.zh: 他对该论点的反驳很有说服力。

questions.content: The ___ of resources is a major constraint.
questions.explanation: the + 名词 scarcity。
questions.zh: 资源稀缺是一个主要制约。

questions.content: There is growing ___ about the policy.
questions.explanation: 不可数名词 concern 表示「担忧」。
questions.zh: 人们对这项政策的担忧日益增长。

questions.content: The ___ of the scheme was questioned.
questions.explanation: the + 名词 feasibility。
questions.zh: 该方案的可行性受到质疑。

questions.content: His ___ for detail is remarkable.
questions.explanation: an eye for detail 意为「对细节的敏锐」。
questions.zh: 他对细节的敏锐令人称奇。

questions.content: The ___ of the report is confidential.
questions.explanation: the content of 意为「……的内容」。
questions.zh: 这份报告的内容是保密的。

questions.content: There is no ___ that he is qualified.
questions.explanation: no doubt that 意为「毫无疑问」。
questions.zh: 毫无疑问他是合格的。

questions.content: She did the job ___ .
questions.explanation: 修饰动词 did 用副词 well。
questions.zh: 这份工作她做得好。

questions.content: She drives very ___ .
questions.explanation: 修饰动词用副词 carefully。
questions.zh: 她开车很小心。

questions.content: They arrived ___ .
questions.explanation: late 意为「晚」；lately 意为「最近」。
questions.zh: 他们来晚了。

questions.content: I haven't seen him ___ .
questions.explanation: lately 意为「最近」，常与现在完成时连用。
questions.zh: 我最近没见过他。

questions.content: She works ___ than anyone else.
questions.explanation: hard 的比较级是 harder，意为「更努力」。
questions.zh: 她比任何人都努力。

questions.content: I can ___ hear you.
questions.explanation: hardly 意为「几乎不」。
questions.zh: 我几乎听不见你说话。

questions.content: He finished the test ___ .
questions.explanation: 修饰动词用副词 quickly。
questions.zh: 他很快就做完了测试。

questions.content: She sings ___ .
questions.explanation: 修饰动词用副词 beautifully。
questions.zh: 她唱得很美。

questions.content: The report was ___ researched.
questions.explanation: 修饰过去分词 researched 用副词。
questions.zh: 这份报告研究得很透彻。

questions.content: ___ , the plan did not work.
questions.explanation: 句首修饰整句用副词 Unfortunately。
questions.zh: 遗憾的是，计划没有奏效。

questions.content: He was ___ injured in the accident.
questions.explanation: 修饰过去分词 injured 用副词。
questions.zh: 他在事故中受了重伤。

questions.content: She is ___ aware of the risk.
questions.explanation: 修饰形容词 aware 用副词 fully。
questions.zh: 她完全清楚风险。

questions.content: The results were ___ unexpected.
questions.explanation: 修饰形容词用副词。
questions.zh: 结果完全出乎意料。

questions.content: He ___ admitted his mistake.
questions.explanation: 修饰动词用副词 eventually。
questions.zh: 他最终承认了自己的错误。

questions.content: She handled the situation ___ .
questions.explanation: 修饰动词用副词。
questions.zh: 她很专业地处理了这个局面。

questions.content: The train was ___ delayed.
questions.explanation: 修饰过去分词 delayed 用副词。
questions.zh: 火车轻微晚点。

questions.content: He is ___ the best candidate.
questions.explanation: arguably 意为「可以说」，修饰整个判断。
questions.zh: 可以说他是最合适的人选。

questions.content: She was ___ late for the meeting.
questions.explanation: 此处应为 usual（as usual 结构）之外的常见搭配；usually 表示「通常」。
questions.zh: 她开会通常都会迟到。

questions.content: The two approaches differ ___ .
questions.explanation: 修饰动词 differ 用副词。
questions.zh: 这两种方法有本质区别。

questions.content: He responded ___ to the criticism.
questions.explanation: 修饰动词用副词。
questions.zh: 他对批评的回应带着防御性。

questions.content: The scheme was ___ funded.
questions.explanation: 修饰过去分词 funded 用副词。
questions.zh: 该方案得到了充足的资金支持。

questions.content: She spoke ___ about her plans.
questions.explanation: 修饰动词 spoke 用副词。
questions.zh: 她坦率地谈了自己的计划。

questions.content: The evidence was ___ weak.
questions.explanation: notoriously 意为「出了名地」，修饰形容词。
questions.zh: 这些证据出了名地薄弱。

questions.content: The results were ___ consistent.
questions.explanation: 修饰形容词 consistent 用副词。
questions.zh: 结果异常一致。

questions.content: He was ___ criticised for the decision.
questions.explanation: 修饰过去分词 criticised 用副词 widely。
questions.zh: 他因这个决定受到广泛批评。

questions.content: The claim is ___ unfounded.
questions.explanation: 修饰形容词 unfounded 用副词。
questions.zh: 这一说法完全没有根据。

questions.content: She is ___ regarded as an expert.
questions.explanation: 修饰过去分词 regarded 用副词。
questions.zh: 她普遍被认为是专家。

questions.content: The findings were ___ reported.
questions.explanation: 修饰过去分词 reported 用副词。
questions.zh: 这些发现被准确地报道了。

questions.content: He ___ underestimated the difficulty.
questions.explanation: grossly 意为「严重地、极度地」，修饰动词。
questions.zh: 他严重低估了难度。

questions.content: The two are ___ related.
questions.explanation: closely related 意为「密切相关」。
questions.zh: 两者密切相关。

questions.content: The policy was ___ implemented.
questions.explanation: 修饰过去分词 implemented 用副词。
questions.zh: 该政策执行得很差。

questions.content: She was ___ surprised by the news.
questions.explanation: utterly 意为「完全地」，修饰形容词。
questions.zh: 这个消息让她完全惊呆了。

questions.content: The argument is ___ sound.
questions.explanation: theoretically sound 意为「理论上站得住脚」。
questions.zh: 这个论证在理论上站得住脚。

questions.content: He was ___ responsible for the failure.
questions.explanation: largely 意为「在很大程度上」。
questions.zh: 他对这次失败负有很大责任。

questions.content: The scheme was ___ successful.
questions.explanation: partially 意为「部分地」，修饰形容词。
questions.zh: 该方案部分成功。

questions.content: I saw ___ elephant at the zoo.
questions.explanation: elephant 以元音音素开头，用 an。
questions.zh: 我在动物园看到一头大象。

questions.content: She is ___ teacher.
questions.explanation: teacher 以辅音音素开头，用 a。
questions.zh: 她是一名老师。

questions.content: ___ sun rises in the east.
questions.explanation: 世界上独一无二的事物前用 the。
questions.zh: 太阳从东边升起。

questions.content: I go to ___ school by bus.
questions.explanation: go to school 表示去上学这一活动，不加冠词。
questions.zh: 我坐公交车上学。

questions.content: He plays ___ piano very well.
questions.explanation: 演奏乐器前用 the。
questions.zh: 他钢琴弹得很好。

questions.content: I like ___ music.
questions.explanation: 泛指的音乐（不可数）不加冠词。
questions.zh: 我喜欢音乐。

questions.content: There is ___ apple on the table.
questions.explanation: apple 以元音音素开头。
questions.zh: 桌上有一个苹果。

questions.content: ___ cat is sleeping on the sofa.
questions.explanation: 特指那只猫，用 the。
questions.zh: 那只猫在沙发上睡觉。

questions.content: We have ___ breakfast at seven.
questions.explanation: 三餐前一般不加冠词。
questions.zh: 我们七点吃早饭。

questions.content: She goes to ___ bed at ten.
questions.explanation: go to bed 是固定说法，不加冠词。
questions.zh: 她十点上床睡觉。

questions.content: He is ___ honest man.
questions.explanation: honest 的 h 不发音，以元音音素开头，用 an。
questions.zh: 他是个诚实的人。

questions.content: It took me ___ hour to finish.
questions.explanation: hour 的 h 不发音，用 an。
questions.zh: 我花了一个小时完成。

questions.content: This is ___ best book I've read.
questions.explanation: 最高级前用 the。
questions.zh: 这是我读过最好的书。

questions.content: ___ rich should help the poor.
questions.explanation: the + 形容词表示一类人。
questions.zh: 富人应该帮助穷人。

questions.content: I've never seen ___ such beautiful place.
questions.explanation: such + 形容词 + 不可数或复数名词时不加冠词；此处 place 为可数单数，such a beautiful place 更常见，故选不加冠词形式。
questions.zh: 我从没见过这么美的地方。

questions.content: She is ___ only child in the family.
questions.explanation: only 前用 the。
questions.zh: 她是家里唯一的孩子。

questions.content: He was elected ___ president.
questions.explanation: 表示独一无二的职位作表语时不加冠词。
questions.zh: 他当选为总统。

questions.content: We went to ___ Great Wall last summer.
questions.explanation: 专有名词中的建筑物名常用 the。
questions.zh: 去年夏天我们去了长城。

questions.content: ___ Mount Everest is the highest peak.
questions.explanation: 山峰名前一般不加冠词。
questions.zh: 珠穆朗玛峰是最高的山峰。

questions.content: I need ___ new pair of shoes.
questions.explanation: a pair of 是固定量词结构。
questions.zh: 我需要一双新鞋。

questions.content: He plays ___ violin in an orchestra.
questions.explanation: 演奏乐器前用 the。
questions.zh: 他在乐团里拉小提琴。

questions.content: ___ life would be boring without challenges.
questions.explanation: 泛指的人生/生活不加冠词。
questions.zh: 没有挑战的人生会很无聊。

questions.content: She was ___ first to arrive.
questions.explanation: 序数词前用 the。
questions.zh: 她是第一个到的。

questions.content: They live in ___ Netherlands.
questions.explanation: 部分国家名（如 Netherlands、Philippines）前用 the。
questions.zh: 他们住在荷兰。

questions.content: I have ___ headache.
questions.explanation: 表示病痛常用 a + 名词。
questions.zh: 我头疼。

questions.content: He goes to ___ work by train.
questions.explanation: go to work 是固定说法。
questions.zh: 他坐火车去上班。

questions.content: ___ information you gave me was useful.
questions.explanation: 特指你给我的那些信息，用 the。
questions.zh: 你给我的信息很有用。

questions.content: This is ___ unique opportunity.
questions.explanation: unique 以辅音音素 /j/ 开头，用 a。
questions.zh: 这是一个独特的机会。

questions.content: ___ unemployment has risen sharply.
questions.explanation: 抽象名词泛指时不加冠词。
questions.zh: 失业率大幅上升。

questions.content: He is ___ university student.
questions.explanation: university 以辅音音素 /j/ 开头，用 a。
questions.zh: 他是一名大学生。

questions.content: ___ Alps are in Europe.
questions.explanation: 山脉名前用 the。
questions.zh: 阿尔卑斯山脉在欧洲。

questions.content: I've been to ___ Japan twice.
questions.explanation: 大多数国名前不加冠词。
questions.zh: 我去过日本两次。

questions.content: She plays ___ basketball every weekend.
questions.explanation: 球类运动前不加冠词。
questions.zh: 她每个周末打篮球。

questions.content: ___ more you practise, the better you get.
questions.explanation: the more... the better... 是固定结构。
questions.zh: 练得越多，你就越好。

questions.content: He was ___ first person to complain.
questions.explanation: 序数词 first 前用 the。
questions.zh: 他是第一个抱怨的人。

questions.content: This book is ___ than that one.
questions.explanation: 多音节形容词的比较级用 more + 原级。
questions.zh: 这本书比那本有趣。

questions.content: He runs ___ than I do.
questions.explanation: 单音节副词的比较级加 -er。
questions.zh: 他跑得比我快。

questions.content: This is the ___ film of the year.
questions.explanation: good 的最高级是 best。
questions.zh: 这是年度最佳影片。

questions.content: She is as ___ as her mother.
questions.explanation: as... as 之间用原级。
questions.zh: 她和她妈妈一样高。

questions.content: The weather is ___ than yesterday.
questions.explanation: bad 的比较级是 worse。
questions.zh: 天气比昨天差。

questions.content: My phone is ___ than yours.
questions.explanation: 多音节形容词用 more 构成比较级。
questions.zh: 我的手机比你的贵。

questions.content: She is not ___ clever as her brother.
questions.explanation: 否定比较用 not so... as。
questions.zh: 她不如她哥哥聪明。

questions.content: This is ___ easiest question.
questions.explanation: 最高级前用 the。
questions.zh: 这是最容易的问题。

questions.content: He is ___ older than his wife.
questions.explanation: much 修饰比较级，表示程度。
questions.zh: 他比他妻子大得多。

questions.content: The queue was ___ than we thought.
questions.explanation: 单音节形容词比较级加 -er。
questions.zh: 队伍比我们想的要长。

questions.content: The more you read, ___ you learn.
questions.explanation: the more... the more... 是固定结构。
questions.zh: 读得越多，学到的越多。

questions.content: This problem is ___ more difficult than it seems.
questions.explanation: much 修饰比较级。
questions.zh: 这个问题比看起来难得多。

questions.content: He is ___ of the two brothers.
questions.explanation: 两者中较……的一个用 the + 比较级。
questions.zh: 他是两兄弟中较高的那个。

questions.content: She is ___ than she looks.
questions.explanation: than 前用比较级。
questions.zh: 她比看起来年龄大。

questions.content: This is by far ___ best option.
questions.explanation: 最高级前用 the，by far 加强语气。
questions.zh: 这显然是最好的选择。

questions.content: The earlier you book, ___ the price.
questions.explanation: the + 比较级... the + 比较级 表示同步变化。
questions.zh: 订得越早，价格越低。

questions.content: He works ___ than anyone else.
questions.explanation: hard 的比较级是 harder。
questions.zh: 他比任何人都努力。

questions.content: This is ___ more useful than that.
questions.explanation: far 可修饰比较级，表示程度大。
questions.zh: 这个比那个有用得多。

questions.content: My results were no ___ than last time.
questions.explanation: no better than 意为「不比……好」。
questions.zh: 我的成绩不比上次好。

questions.content: She speaks ___ fluently than her teacher.
questions.explanation: 多音节副词的比较级用 more。
questions.zh: 她说得比她的老师更流利。

questions.content: The test was ___ easier than expected.
questions.explanation: a lot 可修饰比较级，表示程度。
questions.zh: 这次测试比预期容易得多。

questions.content: This is the ___ important issue we face.
questions.explanation: 多音节形容词的最高级用 most。
questions.zh: 这是我们面临的最重要的问题。

questions.content: He is ___ less experienced than his colleague.
questions.explanation: much 修饰 less + 形容词的比较结构。
questions.zh: 他的经验比他同事少得多。

questions.content: The data is far ___ reliable than the earlier sample.
questions.explanation: far 修饰比较级 more reliable。
questions.zh: 这些数据比早先的样本可靠得多。

questions.content: Nothing is ___ than a good night's sleep.
questions.explanation: 否定词 + 比较级表示最高级含义。
questions.zh: 没有什么比睡个好觉更好的了。

questions.content: She is ___ more capable than her predecessor.
questions.explanation: significantly 修饰比较级，表示程度显著。
questions.zh: 她比前任能干得多。

questions.content: The second proposal is ___ preferable to the first.
questions.explanation: far 修饰 preferable 表示程度。
questions.zh: 第二个提案比第一个好得多。

questions.content: This method is no ___ effective than the old one.
questions.explanation: no more effective than 意为「并不比……更有效」。
questions.zh: 这个方法并不比旧方法更有效。

questions.content: He is ___ the most qualified candidate.
questions.explanation: by far 与最高级连用，表示「显然」。
questions.zh: 他显然是最合格的人选。

questions.content: The results were ___ better than anticipated.
questions.explanation: 副词 substantially 修饰比较级 better。
questions.zh: 结果比预期好得多。

questions.content: The issue is ___ more complex than it first appeared.
questions.explanation: 副词 considerably 修饰比较级。
questions.zh: 这个问题比初看时复杂得多。

questions.content: Few things are ___ important than trust.
questions.explanation: few + 比较级 表示「很少有比……更……的」。
questions.zh: 很少有比信任更重要的东西。

questions.content: This is ___ the best solution available.
questions.explanation: far and away 与最高级连用，意为「远远地」。
questions.zh: 这无疑是目前最好的方案。

questions.content: Her analysis was ___ more thorough than mine.
questions.explanation: 副词 infinitely 修饰比较级。
questions.zh: 她的分析比我的周密得多。

questions.content: The two are ___ alike than they appear.
questions.explanation: more alike than 表示「比看起来更像」。
questions.zh: 两者比表面上更像。

questions.content: It was raining; ___ , we went out.
questions.explanation: however 表示转折。
questions.zh: 当时在下雨；然而我们还是出去了。

questions.content: He was tired; ___ , he kept working.
questions.explanation: nevertheless 表示让步转折。
questions.zh: 他累了；尽管如此，他还是继续工作。

questions.content: She studied hard; ___ , she passed.
questions.explanation: therefore 表示因果关系。
questions.zh: 她学习很努力，因此通过了。

questions.content: ___ , I'd like to thank everyone.
questions.explanation: finally 用于引出最后一点。
questions.zh: 最后，我想感谢所有人。

questions.content: First, we plan; ___ , we act.
questions.explanation: then 表示顺序上的接着。
questions.zh: 我们先计划，然后再行动。

questions.content: ___ , let me explain the background.
questions.explanation: First of all 用于引出第一点。
questions.zh: 首先，让我说明一下背景。

questions.content: ___ the cost, the plan is impractical.
questions.explanation: apart from 意为「除……之外」。
questions.zh: 除了成本之外，这个计划也不切实际。

questions.content: ___ , the results were encouraging.
questions.explanation: on the whole 意为「总的来说」。
questions.zh: 总的来说，结果令人鼓舞。

questions.content: He failed; ___ , he learned a lot.
questions.explanation: however 表示转折。
questions.zh: 他失败了，不过学到了很多。

questions.content: ___ , we should consider the alternatives.
questions.explanation: furthermore 表示递进。
questions.zh: 此外，我们还应该考虑其他选择。

questions.content: ___ , the evidence is inconclusive.
questions.explanation: in short 意为「简而言之」。
questions.zh: 简而言之，证据不足以定论。

questions.content: The plan failed; ___ , we lost money.
questions.explanation: consequently 表示结果。
questions.zh: 计划失败了，结果我们赔了钱。

questions.content: ___ , there is no easy solution.
questions.explanation: 句首用副词 Unfortunately。
questions.zh: 遗憾的是，没有简单的解决办法。

questions.content: ___ , the two issues are unrelated.
questions.explanation: on the contrary 意为「恰恰相反」。
questions.zh: 恰恰相反，这两个问题互不相关。

questions.content: ___ , let me summarise the main points.
questions.explanation: to conclude 用于引出结论。
questions.zh: 最后，让我总结一下要点。

questions.content: ___ , the policy has had unintended effects.
questions.explanation: arguably 意为「可以说」，用于缓和论断。
questions.zh: 可以说，这项政策产生了意料之外的后果。

questions.content: The findings are limited; ___ , they are useful.
questions.explanation: nevertheless 表示让步转折。
questions.zh: 这些发现有其局限，尽管如此仍有用。

questions.content: ___ , the two theories are incompatible.
questions.explanation: in essence 意为「本质上」。
questions.zh: 本质上，这两种理论互不相容。

questions.content: ___ , the sample was too small.
questions.explanation: admittedly 意为「诚然、无可否认」。
questions.zh: 诚然，样本量太小。

questions.content: ___ , the results support the hypothesis.
questions.explanation: taken together 意为「综合来看」。
questions.zh: 综合来看，结果支持这一假设。

questions.content: ___ , this is a matter of principle.
questions.explanation: ultimately 意为「归根结底」。
questions.zh: 归根结底，这是原则问题。

questions.content: ___ , the project was a qualified success.
questions.explanation: all in all 意为「总的来说」。
questions.zh: 总的来说，这个项目算是成功的。

questions.content: ___ , no such evidence has emerged.
questions.explanation: to date 意为「迄今为止」。
questions.zh: 迄今为止，尚未出现这样的证据。

questions.content: ___ , the argument rests on shaky assumptions.
questions.explanation: in effect 意为「实际上」。
questions.zh: 实际上，这个论证建立在不可靠的假设上。

questions.content: ___ , the evidence points the other way.
questions.explanation: if anything 意为「要说有什么不同的话」。
questions.zh: 要说有什么不同的话，证据指向相反方向。

questions.content: ___ , the reforms were half-hearted.
questions.explanation: by and large 意为「大体上」。
questions.zh: 大体上，这些改革是三心二意的。

questions.content: ___ , the two are not mutually exclusive.
questions.explanation: that said 意为「话虽如此」。
questions.zh: 话虽如此，两者并不互斥。

questions.content: ___ , the decision was inevitable.
questions.explanation: with hindsight 意为「事后看来」。
questions.zh: 事后看来，这个决定是不可避免的。

questions.content: ___ , the report avoids the central question.
questions.explanation: significantly 在此作句子副词，意为「值得注意的是」。
questions.zh: 值得注意的是，报告回避了核心问题。

questions.content: ___ , the proposal is worth pursuing.
questions.explanation: on balance 意为「权衡之后」。
questions.zh: 权衡之后，这个提案值得推进。

questions.content: I like tea ___ coffee.
questions.explanation: and 表示并列。
questions.zh: 我喜欢茶和咖啡。

questions.content: He is tired, ___ he keeps working.
questions.explanation: but 表示转折。
questions.zh: 他累了，但还在继续工作。

questions.content: It was late, ___ we went home.
questions.explanation: so 表示结果。
questions.zh: 天晚了，所以我们回家了。

questions.content: Would you like tea ___ coffee?
questions.explanation: or 表示选择。
questions.zh: 你想要茶还是咖啡？

questions.content: ___ he is young, he is very capable.
questions.explanation: although 引导让步状语从句。
questions.zh: 虽然他年轻，但很有能力。

questions.content: ___ it was raining, we stayed inside.
questions.explanation: because 引导原因状语从句。
questions.zh: 因为下雨，我们待在里面。

questions.content: Both Tom ___ Jerry came.
questions.explanation: both... and... 是固定搭配。
questions.zh: 汤姆和杰里都来了。

questions.content: Either you ___ I must go.
questions.explanation: either... or... 是固定搭配。
questions.zh: 要么你去，要么我去。

questions.content: Neither he ___ his brother came.
questions.explanation: neither... nor... 是固定搭配。
questions.zh: 他和他的哥哥都没来。

questions.content: He was tired, ___ he didn't stop.
questions.explanation: but 表示转折。
questions.zh: 他累了，但没有停下来。

questions.content: ___ he had finished, he left.
questions.explanation: after 引导时间状语从句。
questions.zh: 他完成后就离开了。

questions.content: We waited ___ he arrived.
questions.explanation: until 引导时间状语从句，表示「直到」。
questions.zh: 我们一直等到他来。

questions.content: ___ he was reading, she was cooking.
questions.explanation: while 引导的从句表示持续动作。
questions.zh: 他看书的时候她在做饭。

questions.content: He works hard ___ he wants to succeed.
questions.explanation: because 引导原因状语从句。
questions.zh: 他努力工作是因为他想成功。

questions.content: ___ you study, you will fail.
questions.explanation: unless 意为「除非」。
questions.zh: 除非你学习，否则你会不及格。

questions.content: He is not only clever ___ also hard-working.
questions.explanation: not only... but also... 是固定搭配。
questions.zh: 他不仅聪明，而且勤奋。

questions.content: ___ hard he tried, he couldn't win.
questions.explanation: however + 副词，表示「无论多么」。
questions.zh: 无论他多努力，都赢不了。

questions.content: We'll go ___ the weather is good.
questions.explanation: as long as 意为「只要」。
questions.zh: 只要天气好我们就去。

questions.content: ___ it rains, we'll cancel.
questions.explanation: in case 后接从句。
questions.zh: 万一下雨，我们就取消。

questions.content: He kept silent ___ he was angry.
questions.explanation: even though 意为「即使、尽管」，语气强于 though。
questions.zh: 尽管他很生气，他还是保持沉默。

questions.content: ___ he arrived, we started eating.
questions.explanation: as soon as 意为「一……就……」。
questions.zh: 他一到我们就开始吃饭。

questions.content: Both the manager ___ the staff agreed.
questions.explanation: both... and... 是固定搭配。
questions.zh: 经理和员工都同意了。

questions.content: ___ the cost nor the time was acceptable.
questions.explanation: neither... nor... 是固定搭配。
questions.zh: 成本和时间都不可接受。

questions.content: He was late, ___ he missed the start.
questions.explanation: so 表示结果。
questions.zh: 他迟到了，所以错过了开头。

questions.content: ___ she was tired, she finished the work.
questions.explanation: although 引导让步状语从句。
questions.zh: 尽管累了，她还是完成了工作。

questions.content: ___ the difficulties, the project succeeded.
questions.explanation: notwithstanding 是正式介词，意为「尽管」。
questions.zh: 尽管有困难，项目还是成功了。

questions.content: He resigned ___ he was offered a better post.
questions.explanation: because 引导原因状语从句。
questions.zh: 他辞职了，因为有人给了他更好的职位。

questions.content: ___ the evidence, the case was dismissed.
questions.explanation: given 作介词，意为「考虑到」。
questions.zh: 考虑到证据情况，案件被驳回。

questions.content: ___ that the funding is secured, we can proceed.
questions.explanation: provided that 意为「只要」。
questions.zh: 只要资金到位，我们就可以推进。

questions.content: He acted ___ he owned the place.
questions.explanation: as if 意为「好像」。
questions.zh: 他的举止好像他是这儿的主人。

questions.content: The man ___ lives next door is a doctor.
questions.explanation: 先行词指人，作从句主语用 who。
questions.zh: 住在隔壁的那个男人是医生。

questions.content: The book ___ I bought is interesting.
questions.explanation: 先行词指物，用 which。
questions.zh: 我买的那本书很有趣。

questions.content: This is the girl ___ father is a pilot.
questions.explanation: 表示所属关系用 whose。
questions.zh: 这就是那个父亲是飞行员的女孩。

questions.content: The house ___ we live in is old.
questions.explanation: 先行词指物，用 which。
questions.zh: 我们住的房子很旧。

questions.content: I know a man ___ can help you.
questions.explanation: 先行词指人，作主语用 who。
questions.zh: 我认识一个能帮你的人。

questions.content: The film ___ we saw was boring.
questions.explanation: 先行词指物，that 与 which 均可。
questions.zh: 我们看的那部电影很无聊。

questions.content: This is the place ___ we met.
questions.explanation: 先行词是地点且从句缺状语，用 where。
questions.zh: 这就是我们相遇的地方。

questions.content: The reason ___ he left is unknown.
questions.explanation: 先行词 reason 后接关系副词 why。
questions.zh: 他离开的原因不明。

questions.content: The day ___ we met was sunny.
questions.explanation: 先行词是时间，用关系副词 when。
questions.zh: 我们相遇那天是晴天。

questions.content: He is the person ___ I spoke to.
questions.explanation: 关系代词作介词宾语，指人用 whom。
questions.zh: 他就是我交谈过的那个人。

questions.content: All ___ glitters is not gold.
questions.explanation: 先行词为 all 时关系代词只能用 that。
questions.zh: 闪光的不都是金子。

questions.content: This is the best film ___ I have seen.
questions.explanation: 先行词被最高级修饰时用 that。
questions.zh: 这是我看过最好的电影。

questions.content: The only thing ___ matters is health.
questions.explanation: 先行词被 only 修饰时用 that。
questions.zh: 唯一重要的是健康。

questions.content: She has two brothers, ___ are doctors.
questions.explanation: 非限制性定语从句不用 that，指人用 who。
questions.zh: 她有两个哥哥，都是医生。

questions.content: The car, ___ was stolen, has been found.
questions.explanation: 非限制性定语从句指物用 which。
questions.zh: 那辆被偷的车已经找到了。

questions.content: Everything ___ he said was true.
questions.explanation: 先行词为 everything 时用 that。
questions.zh: 他说的一切都是真的。

questions.content: The woman ___ car was stolen called the police.
questions.explanation: 表示所属关系用 whose。
questions.zh: 车被偷的那个女人报了警。

questions.content: I don't know the reason ___ she refused.
questions.explanation: 先行词 reason 后用 why。
questions.zh: 我不知道她拒绝的原因。

questions.content: There were no seats ___ were free.
questions.explanation: 先行词被 no 修饰时用 that。
questions.zh: 没有空着的座位。

questions.content: He lives in a town ___ is near the coast.
questions.explanation: 从句缺主语，用关系代词 which。
questions.zh: 他住在一个靠近海岸的镇上。

questions.content: The proposal, ___ was submitted last week, was rejected.
questions.explanation: 非限制性定语从句不用 that。
questions.zh: 上周提交的那份提案被否决了。

questions.content: He is the only one ___ can solve it.
questions.explanation: 先行词被 the only one 修饰时用 that。
questions.zh: 他是唯一能解决它的人。

questions.content: The extent ___ the policy worked is debated.
questions.explanation: the extent to which 是固定搭配。
questions.zh: 该政策起效的程度有争议。

questions.content: She spoke to the manager, ___ was very helpful.
questions.explanation: 非限制性定语从句指人用 who。
questions.zh: 她和经理谈过，经理很帮忙。

questions.content: The point ___ I want to make is simple.
questions.explanation: 先行词 the point 在从句中作 make 的宾语，可用 that 或 which。
questions.zh: 我想说的这一点很简单。

questions.content: We regret ___ you that your application was unsuccessful.
questions.explanation: 正式函件中 regret to inform 是惯用表达。
questions.zh: 很遗憾通知您，您的申请未获通过。

questions.content: ___ to your enquiry of 3 May, we can confirm the details.
questions.explanation: further to 是正式商务函件的开头用语，意为「关于」。
questions.zh: 关于您 5 月 3 日的询问，我们可以确认相关细节。

questions.content: Please find ___ the requested documents.
questions.explanation: please find enclosed 是正式函件用语。
questions.zh: 随函附上您所需的文件。

questions.content: I am writing with ___ to your recent advertisement.
questions.explanation: with regard to 是正式用语，意为「关于」。
questions.zh: 我写信是想咨询您最近的广告。

questions.content: Should you require ___ information, please contact us.
questions.explanation: further information 意为「更多信息」，正式用语。
questions.zh: 如需更多信息，请联系我们。

questions.content: We would be grateful ___ you could confirm by Friday.
questions.explanation: we would be grateful if 是正式请求用语。
questions.zh: 如果您能在周五前确认，我们将不胜感激。

questions.content: I look forward to ___ from you at your earliest convenience.
questions.explanation: look forward to 后接动名词，是正式函件常用结束语。
questions.zh: 期待您尽早回复。

questions.content: The report ___ that immediate action be taken.
questions.explanation: 主句主语单数，用 recommends；后接虚拟语气 be taken。
questions.zh: 报告建议立即采取行动。

questions.content: ___ is hereby given that the meeting is postponed.
questions.explanation: notice is hereby given 是正式公告用语。
questions.zh: 特此通知，会议延期。

questions.content: The parties ___ agree to the terms set out below.
questions.explanation: hereby 是法律文书用语，意为「特此」。
questions.zh: 双方特此同意下列条款。

questions.content: Any breach of this clause shall ___ the contract void.
questions.explanation: shall 后接动词原形，render sth void 意为「使……无效」。
questions.zh: 违反本条款将使合同失效。

questions.content: The foregoing ___ notwithstanding, the clause stands.
questions.explanation: the foregoing provisions 意为「上述条款」，法律用语。
questions.zh: 尽管有上述条款，本条款仍然有效。

questions.content: We ___ your prompt attention to this matter.
questions.explanation: 主语 We 用动词原形 request，正式用语。
questions.zh: 我们请您尽快处理此事。

questions.content: I should be ___ if you would send the details.
questions.explanation: I should be grateful if... 是正式请求用语。
questions.zh: 如蒙您告知详情，我将不胜感激。

questions.content: The findings ___ with the conclusions of earlier studies.
questions.explanation: 主语 the findings 为复数，用动词原形 accord；accord with 意为「与……一致」。
questions.zh: 这些发现与早先研究的结论一致。

questions.content: Please ___ us of any change of address.
questions.explanation: notify sb of sth 是正式用语，意为「通知某人某事」。
questions.zh: 地址如有变更请通知我们。

questions.content: This agreement ___ into force upon signature.
questions.explanation: 主语 This agreement 单数，用 enters。
questions.zh: 本协议自签署之日起生效。

questions.content: ___ accordance with your instructions, we have processed the order.
questions.explanation: in accordance with 是正式用语，意为「依照」。
questions.zh: 依照您的指示，我们已处理订单。

questions.content: We ___ to inform you of a change to our schedule.
questions.explanation: 主语 We 用 write；we write to inform you 是正式函件开头。
questions.zh: 我们致函通知您日程的变动。

questions.content: The aforementioned documents ___ attached for your reference.
questions.explanation: 主语 documents 复数，用 are。
questions.zh: 上述文件随附供您参考。
